| `Job` (2684) | `id`, `genId`, `name`, `state`, `progress`, `meta`, `detail`, `kind`, `retry?`, `want`, `landed` | none - this type has no `fromJson` and no `toJson`; it is client-only | `landed` is a client-side once-only guard | neither |
| `LedgerRow` (2745) | `id`, `op`, `model`, `genId?`, `evId?`, `tokensIn`, `tokensOut`, `thoughts`, `images`, `videoSeconds`, `cost`, `at`, `note` | `op` ← `operation`; `genId` ← `generator`; `evId` ← `evaluator_id`; `thoughts` ← `thoughts_tokens`; `images` ← `image_count`; `cost` ← `cost_usd` (double fallback, :5348); `at` ← `create_date`, **defaults to `DateTime.now()`** when unparseable (:962) | `totalTokens`, `attributedTo`, `videoSeconds` rounded from a double | fromJson only |
| `Tag` (2813) | `id`, `name`, `uses`, `mergeInto?` | `uses` ← `uses` \| `usage_count`; `id` via `jid` (a `jval<String>` here returned `''` for Odoo's integer id and broke every merge, :158) | `facet` (:5450), `isCanonical` | both |

##### Dates and times: India Standard Time on every screen - **added in 19.0.3.23.0**

Every timestamp a person reads is printed in IST, candidates and staff alike, with the zone named, because a bare "10:04 PM" is read as the reader's own clock (rows 45 and 60). IST is a fixed UTC+05:30 with no daylight saving, so the helpers in `domain/models.dart` shift by a constant and need no timezone database:

| Helper | Output | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `inIst(at)` | the instant shifted by +05:30 | read only its date and clock fields - it is not a real instant any more. A BARE DATE needs it too: `.day` on a UTC stamp (or on `toLocal()`) names the previous day for anything between midnight and 05:30 IST |
| `istShortDate(at)` | `21/9/2026` | the candidate's own short date (My results, My performance, dashboard "Starts") |
| `istTimestamp(at, {now})` | `10:03 AM IST` today, `18 Sep, 10:03 AM IST` this year, `18 Sep 2025, 10:03 AM IST` before | the one clock format; `_istClock` is the only place the "IST" label is written |
| `istDateAtTime(at)` | `Sep 21, 2026 at 10:04pm IST` | a moment inside a sentence ("Scored 630/630 candidates on ...") |
| `humanWhen(raw)` | `istTimestamp` of a parsed wire string; unparseable text is returned as is | no longer relative ("5 min ago", "3 days ago"): it is an IST timestamp now |

Where they are used: chatter lines and email rows (`istTimestamp`, replacing each panel's own relative-time `_when`), ledger sheet "When", bank "Approved" (column widened to 150), the generator's `created` (parsed through `humanWhen` in `Generator.fromJson`; the generator list prints it under the owner, column widened to 128), attempt Session dates, candidate detail, `CandidateFlag` "Raised by ... on <date>", My assessments "Opens ...", My results and My performance dates, Form Studio catalogue dates (`_day` via `inIst`), and the dashboard "Starts" column (`istShortDate`, 110 px, date only - with the time it pushed Avg score off a 1,440 px screen, N9/F1-03). `FormDef.toJson` now writes `updated_at` in UTC with its `Z`, and `FormDef.fromJson` reads a zone-less stamp (the forms route sends `write_date.isoformat()`) as UTC, so an exported form no longer re-imports 5h30 off. Tests: `ist_timestamp_test.dart`, `every_time_on_screen_says_ist_test.dart`, `a_date_alone_is_the_india_date_test.dart`, `human_when_test.dart`.

`domain/category_scores.dart::timeUsed(attempt, asm)` is the matching time-span helper: "38 of 45 min" (or "<1 of 45 min", or "38 min" with no limit), capped at the limit because a sitting settled later by the cron is stamped after the deadline it ended on. It feeds every "Time used" figure on the candidate side (Q12).

#### 3. Enums (enums.dart)

24 enums when this table was written; 29 in 19.0.3.23.0 (the table lists the original set plus `ScoringFilter`). Most carry `(wire, label, tone)` and a static `parse(String?)` built on `values.firstWhere(..., orElse:)`. **An unknown wire value never throws and is never reported** - it silently becomes the fallback in the last column. `AssetState` is the only one that returns `null` instead.

| `Tone` (9) | `ok`, `warn`, `bad`, `info`, `inert`, `accent` - no wire, no parse | n/a |

| `AttemptState` (75) | `pending`, `in_progress`, `submitted` | `completed` or `closed` → `submitted`; everything else → `pending` (:75) |
| `ScoringFilter` (19.0.3.23.0) | `scored` ("Scored"), `score_pending` ("Score Pending") - no parse | n/a. NOT attempt states: the Candidates tab's two chips after Submitted, splitting `submitted` by its ANSWERS server-side (Scored + Score Pending = Submitted). The wire travels in the roster route's `state` parameter and keys `meta.counts` beside the `AttemptState` wires (row 33) |

**The seven question types** (`QType`, `lib/assessment/domain/enums.dart`), each `(wire, label, short)`. Since round 3 (A-053) the enum also has a client-only eighth value, `unsupported` (`'unsupported'`, "Unsupported question type"): what `QType.parse` returns for a type this build does not know; no picker offers it. The enum's own header comment says it mirrors `QUESTION_TYPE_SELECTION` in the module's `constants.py`, and `question_types_test.dart` pins that:

| Value | Wire | Label / short | Objective? | Media | Generatable? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mcq` | `mcq` | Objective · MCQ / MCQ | yes | none | yes |
| `msq` | `msq` | Objective · MSQ / MSQ | yes | none | yes |
| `subjectiveRubric` | `subjective_rubric` | Subjective · Rubric / Rubric | no | none | yes |
| `imageAb` | `image_ab` | Image · A/B evaluation / Image A/B | no | image | yes |
| `imagePrompt` | `image_prompt` | Image · Prompt / Image prompt | no | image | yes |
| `imageLabel` | `image_label` | Image · Labelling / Labelling | no | image | yes |
| `videoPrompt` | `video_prompt` | Video · Prompt / Video prompt | no | video | yes |

Derived members: `isObjective` = mcq or msq (:570); `isSubjective` = its negation, so the other six are all "subjective"; `isGeneratable` excludes only `unsupported` (round 3); `generatable` is the derived picker list (:443); `known` is `values` without `unsupported` (the bank's type filter and its "N of M" card); `needsImage` covers `imageAb`/`imagePrompt`/`imageLabel` only (:446) - note `imageLabel2` is **excluded** despite carrying two plates, so `Question.mediaComplete` never checks its media; `needsVideo` is `videoPrompt`; `isMultiSelect` is `msq` and has no call sites.

State-machine constants worth knowing:
- `LlmState.unresolved` = {pending, queued, scoring, failed, error} (:158). Invariant 4: any subjective answer in this set forces `Attempt.result` to `pending` regardless of score.
- `LlmState.autoRetry` = {pending, queued, failed} - **excludes `error`** deliberately (:192).
- `LlmState.manualRescore` = the same set plus `scoring` and `error` (:173).
- `AsmState.linear` = [draft, inProgress, done]; `cancelled` is drawn separately (:62).
- `PortalCapabilities.can` (:962): `admin` → true for every capability, `member` → false for every capability. There is no per-capability table; the extension is a two-branch switch.

#### 4. Gates (gates.dart)

A **gate** is one evaluated launch condition returned as a `GateResult(name, why, {ok, offenders, warning})` (`:12-30`). `warning` (19.0.3.23.0) marks a row that PASSES but says something to read before launching: it is drawn amber and never blocks, since `ok` stays true and `Gates.allPass` ignores it. The only source today is the server's `grading_keys` gate via `AppStore.launchWarnings` (questions that will be graded with no usable answer key, row 13). `why` states the evidence on a pass and the fault on a failure; `offenders` names up to ten specific questions (`:22`). The rule the file encodes is "evaluate every condition and show them together" (`:37-42`) - nothing short-circuits, `Gates.launch` always returns 7 results and `Gates.draftChecks` always returns 5.

`Gates.launch(asm, {attempts, generator, bank})` (`:37`), in order:

| # | Name | Passes when | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | The assessment is a draft | `asm.state.isDraft` | |
| 2 | At least one candidate is assigned | `rosterCount > 0` | `rosterCount` = matching `Attempt`s if any, else `asm.roster.length` (:54). Before launch no attempts exist, so the roster fallback is what makes this gate correct on a draft |
| 3 | A question generator is selected | `generator != null` | |
| 4 | The generator has usable questions | `pool.isNotEmpty` where `pool` = `bank.where(genId == asm.generatorId && q.launchReady)` (:60) | Counts the generator's whole pool, not the frozen selection |
| 5 | The requested question count is available | `want > 0 && asm.questions.length >= want`; `want` = `questionLimit` if > 0 else `questions.length` (:64) | Fails on a list-row `Assessment` (no nested questions), so this gate needs the detail payload loaded |
| 6 | Every objective question has an answer key | no selected objective question fails `hasCompleteKey` (:71) | Names offenders |
| 7 | Every subjective question has a signed-off rubric | only checked when `asm.requireReviewedRubric`; otherwise trivially passes with "Not required by this assessment." (:75, :130) | Names offenders |

`Gates.draftChecks({name, generatorId, generator, selected, limit, requireReviewedRubric, pool})` (`:141`) returns 5: has a name; a generator is selected; enough questions available (`pool.length >= want`); every objective question has a key; every subjective rubric signed off. It is the authoring-time twin of the launch gates - note it checks the *pool*, while launch gate 5 checks the *selection*.

`Gates.allPass(list)` (`:133`) is the only aggregator.

**Where gates are enforced:**

| Site | What it does |
|---|---|
| `lib/assessment/state/app_store.dart:1075` | `AppStore.launchGates(asm)` binds `Gates.launch` to store state (`attempts`, `genById`, `bank`) |
| `lib/assessment/state/app_store.dart:1146-1150` | `AppStore.launch` refuses and toasts "Launch is blocked" when `!Gates.allPass`. The comment is explicit that this is a courtesy - the server re-runs the same gates and is the actual boundary |
| `lib/assessment/screens/admin/assessment_detail_screen.dart:180-200` | Inline `Notice` on a draft listing the **first two** failing gates plus a "See all checks" button |
| `.../assessment_detail_screen.dart:275-289` | The Launch button stays pressable but degrades to secondary with a "(N to fix)" count |
| `.../assessment_detail_screen.dart:442-470` | The launch sheet: `CheckList(gates)`, primary action disabled while `!ok`. Since 19.0.3.23.0 the sheet starts `launchWarnings(asm)` once when it opens and a `FutureBuilder` appends the server's warning rows to the same list when they arrive; `ok` is computed from the client gates only |
| `lib/assessment/screens/admin/new_assessment_screen.dart:85-94` | `Gates.draftChecks` drives the builder's `ready` flag |
| `lib/assessment/widgets/feedback.dart:100-130` | `CheckList` / `_CheckRow` - the only renderer of `GateResult`: green tick when clean, amber `!` for a warning, red `!` for a failure; the reason and the offenders take the row's tone |

Question-level gate helpers are enforced outside `gates.dart` too: `launchReady` filters `AppStore.poolFor` (`app_store.dart::poolFor`) and the seed equivalent (`seed_data.dart:968`); `blockingWarnings` is Invariant 1, checked in `AppStore.decideDraft` (`app_store.dart::decideDraft`) so no approval route - including the keyboard one - can bypass an unacknowledged blocking warning.

#### 5. Navigation

**Route types** (`lib/assessment/nav.dart`). `AssessmentRoute` is a `@immutable sealed class` (`:25`), so `assessment_section.dart:438` can switch over it exhaustively with no default arm - adding a route is a compile error until it is mapped to a screen. 21 concrete routes:

| Route (line) | Parameters | Screen (`assessment_section.dart:_page`) |
|---|---|---|
| `StartHere` (111) | - | `StartHereScreen` (:439) |
| `Analytics` (116) | - | `DashboardScreen(portal:)` (:440) |
| `MyPerformance` (127) | - | `MyPerformanceScreen` (:441) |
| `AssessmentsList` (29) | - | `AssessmentListScreen(portal:)` (:442) |
| `NewAssessment` (39) | - | `NewAssessmentScreen` (:443) |
| `AssessmentDetail` (33) | `id`, `tab?` | `AssessmentDetailScreen(asmId:, tab:)` (:444) |
| `QuestionBank` (43) | - | `BankScreen` (:450) |
| `GeneratorList` (47) | - | `GeneratorListScreen` (:451) |
| `NewGenerator` (55) | - | `NewGeneratorScreen` (:452) |
| `GeneratorDetail` (59) | `id`, `tab?` | `GeneratorDetailScreen(genId:, tab:)` (:453) |
| `ReviewQueue` (65) | `generatorId?` | `ReviewQueueScreen(genFilter:)` (:458) |
| `ResponsesList` (70) | - | `ResponsesScreen` (:462) |
| `ScoringAdmin` (77) | - | `ScoringScreen` (:463) |
| `ResponseDetail` (81) | `attemptId`, `questionId` | `ResponseDetailScreen` (:464) |
| `AttemptDetail` (87) | `id` | `AttemptDetailScreen(portal:)` (:469) |
| `TagsAdmin` (92) | - | `TagsScreen` (:474) |
| `BudgetAdmin` (96) | - | `BudgetScreen` (:475) |
| `LedgerAdmin` (100) | - | `LedgerScreen` (:476) |
| `SettingsAdmin` (104) | - | `SettingsScreen` (:477) |
| `MyAssessments` (121) | - | `MyAssessmentsScreen` (:478) |
| `Exam` (133) | `token`, `stage` (`ExamStage`, default `gate`), `questionIndex` (default 0) | `ExamScreen(token:, sub:, questionNumber:)`, with `ExamStage` mapped 1:1 onto `ExamSub` - `gate → instructions`, `question → question`, `answers → answers`, `review → review`, `complete → complete` (:482-488) |

`ExamStage` (`nav.dart::ExamStage`) = `{gate, question, answers, review, complete}`. `ExamSub` (`exam_screen.dart::ExamSub`) declares the same five in a different order, which is why the explicit switch exists rather than an index cast.

**The navigator is not a router.** `AssessmentNav` is a `ChangeNotifier` holding a `List<AssessmentRoute>` stack seeded with `AssessmentsList()` (`:184-187`). `reset(r)` clears and replaces (sidebar-level jumps), `go(r)` pushes (drill-downs), `pop()` removes. The file states the consequence plainly (`:10-13`): in-app navigation does not touch the address bar, so no screen except the exam is linkable. The one URL that matters, `/exam/<token>`, is parsed at startup by `lib/deep_link.dart` and passed in as a parameter. Named helpers `startHere/analytics/assessments` use `reset`; `assessment/generator/review/response/attempt/exam*` use `go` (`:219-235`).

`AssessmentNavScope` is an `InheritedNotifier<AssessmentNav>` (`:174`) with `context.nav` sugar (`:174`); `of` **asserts** when the scope is missing, so any screen built outside the section throws on its first navigation. `firstUnanswered(ev, asm)` (`:145`) is a free function returning a 1-based question index, used only by `my_assessments_screen.dart:333`.

**Sidebar entries** (`domain/nav_entries.dart`). `NavEntry(key, label, icon, {group, badge})` - `key` intentionally reuses the section's tab keys so the rail and the router cannot drift (`:14-15`). A heading is rendered by the shell only when `group` *changes* between consecutive entries (`lib/app_shell.dart:198-208`), so an empty leading group produces an unlabelled first block; a badge renders only when `> 0` (`app_shell.dart:283-287`).

Current operator sidebar order, exactly as the code has it (`nav_entries.dart:39-109`):

| # | Key | Label | Group | Badge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `analytics` | Dashboard | (none) | - |
| 2 | `assessments` | Assessments | (none) | - |
| 3 | `generators` | Generators | AUTHORING | - |
| 4 | `review` | Review queue | AUTHORING | `reviewCount` |
| 5 | `bank` | Question bank | AUTHORING | - |
| 6 | `tags` | Tags | AUTHORING | - |
| 7 | `responses` | Responses | RESULTS | `responseCount` |
| 8 | `scoring` | Scoring | RESULTS | - |
| 9 | `budget` | LLM budget | PLATFORM | - |
| 10 | `start` | Docs | PLATFORM | - |
| 11 | `settings` | Settings | PLATFORM | - |

Candidate sidebar (`memberNav`, `:112`): `mine` "My assessments", then `performance` "My performance". No groups.

**Role filtering is a single branch**: `assessment_section.dart:338` - `if (_store.portal == Portal.member) return memberNav(); return operatorNav(...)`. There is no per-`Capability` filtering of nav entries anywhere; `Capability` is consulted only inside screens (`assessment_detail_screen.dart:177,257-259,583`, `attempt_detail_screen.dart:133,138`). Badge counts are supplied by the section from the store: `reviewCount` = `pendingDrafts().length`, `responseCount` = answers whose `llmState == LlmState.pending` (`:343-350`).

#### 6. `assessment_section.dart` - the section host

One `StatefulWidget` that owns the whole product's content area. It does **not** own the session: `AppStore` is injected (`:69,81`) and deliberately not disposed (`:202-206`).

What it wires together:

1. **Entry to root route.** `AssessmentEntry` (`:51`) has 12 members - `console, startHere, analytics, mine, myPerformance, generators, questionBank, reviewQueue, responses, tags, budget, settings` - mapped to `_nav.reset(...)` in `_openEntry` (`:132-176`). `console` lands on `Analytics()`. `examToken` takes precedence over everything (`:144-148`). `_openEntry` is called from both `initState` and `didUpdateWidget` because Flutter reuses the same `State` when the shell swaps entries (`:128-136,188-190`).
2. **Route to screen.** `_page()` (`:578-636`), the exhaustive sealed switch listed in §5.
3. **Route to sidebar highlight.** `_activeTabKey()` (`:487-505`) derives the lit row from the current route rather than storing it, so a drill-down keeps its parent lit: `MyAssessments()` and `Exam()` both → `mine`; `GeneratorList/NewGenerator/GeneratorDetail` → `generators`; `ResponsesList/ResponseDetail/AttemptDetail` → `responses`; default → `assessments`.
4. **Sidebar key to route.** `_openTab(key)` (`:513-530`) `reset`s. It handles 13 keys - the 11 rail entries plus `ledger` and `performance` - and falls through to `AssessmentsList()`.
5. **Chrome.** A `LinearProgressIndicator` while `loadState == loading`, a `Notice` + Retry when `loadState == failed`, the scroll container (the shell hands over a bare content area), `AssessmentNavScope`, and `ToastHost` (`:231-286`).
6. **First-paint skeleton.** `_showListSkeleton` (`:536-552`) requires loading + empty store **and** a route in an explicit allow-list of list-shaped screens; detail, form and exam routes are excluded so a candidate following an invite never sees an admin table skeleton.
7. **The history dock.** `_dockTarget()` (`:359-366`) maps `AssessmentDetail`/`GeneratorDetail`/`AttemptDetail`/`ResponseDetail` (the last borrowing its attempt's id) to a `(kind, id)` record; everything else gets no dock content. `ChatterDock` is a sibling of the content `Row`, not a child, so its open state and width survive navigation (`:295-330`). `_DockTabs` (`:660`) switches between `ChatterPanel` and `EmailsPanel`.
8. **Rail injection.** `sidebarBuilder` is optional; null renders no rail (`:100-108`). The only production caller is `lib/app_shell.dart:90-112`, which passes `entry: isAdmin ? AssessmentEntry.analytics : AssessmentEntry.mine` and builds the 224px `_Sidebar`.
9. **The rail is a drawer on a phone** (19.0.3.23.0, row 49). A `LayoutBuilder` keeps rail + content + dock in one `Row` at `Layout.headerStack` (720 px) and wider; below that it builds a `Scaffold` (key `_narrowShell`) with the rail in a 224px `Drawer` and an `AppBar` titled with the current section's label (`_activeTabLabel()`, falling back to "Assessments"). The rail is built twice through `railWith(onOpen)`: the drawer copy's rows close the drawer before `_openTab`, so the opened page is not left behind the navigation. A 224px rail on a 375px screen left 151px for My Assessments - the first screen an invited candidate sees. The exam runner is unaffected: `_examIsLocked` drops the rail for the whole sitting. Resizing across 720px rebuilds the page. Test: `a_phone_can_reach_my_assessments_test.dart`.

#### 7. Things that look wrong, dead, or contradictory

1. **`Question.copyWith` silently drops `labelBoxes`** (`models.dart:707-737`). Every other field is threaded, including `options` and `correctAnswers` which are not even parameters, but `labelBoxes` is absent from the constructor call, so any `copyWith` resets it to `const []`. Live call sites are in `app_store.dart:949,955,1001,1019` (approve/deny/undo/rubric toggle). This is exactly the bug class the file's own comments warn about at `:1190-1192` and `:2236-2238`.
2. **`Assessment.copyWith` drops all six roll-up counters** (`models.dart:1538-1567`) - `questionsAvailable`, `assignedCount`, `submittedCount`, `releasableCount`, `awaitingScoringCount`, `responseCount` all revert to `-1`. Readers guard with `>= 0` and fall back to counting (`assessment_list_screen.dart:208-229`, `dashboard_screen.dart:143,352-377`), so it degrades rather than crashes, but a local edit blanks server-supplied counts.
3. **FIXED (round 3, A-126) - the dock's `ValueKey`s were not interpolated.** They read `'history-\${widget.kind}-\${widget.recordId}'`, a constant literal, so navigating between two attempts reused the same panel `State`; they now interpolate (`assessment_section.dart::_DockTabsState`).
4. **`nav.dart::StartHere` contradicts `nav_entries.dart:97-102`.** The `StartHere` doc says it is "Deliberately the FIRST sidebar item"; the entry list labels that key "Docs" and places it 10th of 11, under PLATFORM, with a comment explaining precisely the opposite decision. The route doc is stale.
5. **`nav_entries.dart:31-35` says "nine flat rows … three short blocks"** - there are 11 entries and, counting the unlabelled leading block, four blocks. Same stale count appears in `assessment_section.dart:221`, `app_shell.dart:82-84` and `test/assessment/sidebar_reachable_test.dart:9`.
6. **`LedgerAdmin` lights nothing on the rail.** `_activeTabKey` can return `'ledger'` (`:387`) but no `NavEntry` has that key (removal is intentional, `nav_entries.dart:92-94`), so the sidebar shows no selection while the ledger screen is open.
7. **`ScoringAdmin` and `LedgerAdmin` have no `AssessmentEntry`.** The section can route to them (`_openTab`, and `budget_screen.dart:138` pushes the ledger) but a host cannot open the app *on* them.
8. **`test/assessment/sidebar_reachable_test.dart:63-77` re-implements `_openTab` as a copy** that omits `start`, `scoring` and `ledger`. The test therefore cannot catch a regression in the three newest keys, and its header comment still describes the sections as "horizontal tabs".
9. **Misplaced doc comments in models.dart.** `:345-352` documents `_rubricLines` but is attached to `_correctAnswers`; `:386-394` documents `_assetsWithBoxes` but is attached to `_labelBoxNumbers`; `:76-90` stacks two separate doc paragraphs on `jtags`. Reading the doc directly above a function gives the wrong function in three places.
10. **FIXED - stale count in `LedgerOp`'s doc**: it said "The twelve ledger operations" (`enums.dart:690`) over 16 values; the enum (27 values in 19.0.3.23.0) no longer states a count.
11. **`Assessment.durationMinutes` has two different defaults**: the constructor says 60 (`models.dart::durationMinutes`), `fromJson` passes a fallback of 0 (`:1617`). A payload that omits the field yields "no limit", not 60.
12. **Serialisation is lossy in several places** - `QDimension.toJson` omits `id`; `Asset.toJson` omits `annotatedUrl`; `Question.toJson` omits `options`, `correctAnswers`, `labelBoxes`; `Assessment.toJson` omits `requireObjectiveJustification` and every counter; `Generator.toJson` covers roughly half its fields. Anything that round-trips through JSON locally loses those.
13. **Raw casts that can still throw**, despite the `jget`/`jval` discipline: `jget(j,'options') as List<dynamic>?` (`:805`), `jget(j,'boxKey') as Map<String,dynamic>` (`:827`), `jget(j,'rules') as Map<String,dynamic>` (`:1658`), `jget(j,'resp') as Map<String,dynamic>` (`:26`), and `RuleSet.fromJson`'s `(j[r.wire] ?? false) as bool` (`:1362`), which reads the map directly rather than through `jget`.
14. **`ExamView.outcome` is a bare `String`** with seven documented values (`models.dart:2559-2561`) - the only state machine in the domain layer that is not an enum, so a typo in a comparison fails silently.
15. **FIXED (round 3, A-053) - `QType.parse` fell back to `mcq`**, so a type the server added later rendered as an MCQ with nothing to pick. A present but unknown type is now `QType.unsupported`: the runner shows "This question type is not supported in this version of the app." and the candidate can move on and submit; no picker offers it (`isGeneratable`, `known`). A missing type still reads as `mcq`.
16. **Dead members** (no call sites in `lib/` or `test/`): `Portal.homeRoute` (`enums.dart::seg`), `Portal.seg` (`:614`), `QType.isMultiSelect` (`:285`), `AssetState.needsAttention` (`:446`), `JobState.isTerminal` (`:340`), `ProctorRule.parse` (`:557`). `LedgerRow.attributedTo` (`models.dart::attributedTo`) is referenced only by a test - `ledger_screen.dart:35` has its own `_attributedTo`.
17. **`Job` is a domain model with no parser** (`models.dart:2684`) - no `fromJson`, no `toJson`, `JobKind` has no wire strings. It exists only for locally-simulated pipeline runs.
18. UNKNOWN: whether the live server sends a draft's flat answer key as `options`/`correct_answer` or as `options_json`/`correct_answer_json`. The field doc at `models.dart::options` names the `_json` spellings, but `fromJson` reads `options` (`:805`) and `correctAnswer`→`correct_answer` (`:809`), and the write path in `api_client.dart:661` uses `correct_answer`. Only the write key is confirmed by code in this repo.
19. UNKNOWN: `Response.state` is a free-form `String` documented as "`draft` · `submitted`" (`models.dart::submitted`); no enum or parse constrains it, and nothing in the domain layer validates the value.


## 3.5 Screens: dashboard, assessments, attempts, responses

All seven screens live in `lib/assessment/screens/admin/`. They share four mechanics, none of which is per-screen:

| Mechanic | Where | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| Reactivity | every screen wraps its body in `ListenableBuilder(listenable: store, ...)` | `AppStore` is a `ChangeNotifier` (`lib/assessment/state/app_store.dart::AppStore`); any mutation rebuilds every mounted screen |
| Page-level loading | `lib/assessment/assessment_section.dart:238` | a 2px `LinearProgressIndicator` while `store.loadState == LoadState.loading` |
| Page-level error | `lib/assessment/assessment_section.dart:240-251` | a `Tone.bad` `Notice` reading `store.loadError` with a Retry button calling `store.refresh` |
| First-paint skeleton | `lib/assessment/assessment_section.dart:417-431` | list-shaped skeleton only while `loadState == loading && store.isEmpty`, and only for `Analytics`, `AssessmentsList`, `ResponsesList` (+ others). **Not** for the three detail screens or `NewAssessment` |
| Table emptiness | `lib/assessment/widgets/data_grid.dart:83-108` | `DataGrid` with zero rows drops its column headers entirely and renders an `EmptyState` (icon, headline = first sentence of `emptyMessage`, body = the rest, optional `emptyAction`) |

No admin screen reads `loadState` or `loadError` itself. The only per-screen "still arriving" signal is `store.isHydrating(kind, id)` (`app_store.dart::isHydrating`), used by three of the seven.

---

#### 1. `dashboard_screen.dart` (787 lines) - "Assessment analytics"

**Purpose.** Cohort view across every visible assessment. `DashboardScreen` is a `StatelessWidget` taking `store` and `portal` (default `Portal.admin`, `:39-45`).

**What a user sees**, top to bottom:

| Region | Contents | Where |
|---|---|---|
| `PageHead` | "Assessment analytics" + one action: `Btn('Open assessments')` | `:150-161` |
| `KpiStrip` (6 tiles) | Assessments (tappable → assessments list), Candidates, Submitted, Pass rate, Awaiting result, Needs a closer look | `:162-210` |
| `_AnalyticsBand` → "Where the cohort stands" | `StackedBar` of Passed / Failed / Awaiting result / Not started + one generated sentence (`_funnelSentence`, `:882-894`) | `:654-681` |
| `_AnalyticsBand` → "Decided outcomes" | `DonutChart` Passed vs Failed, centre `n/N`, two legend rows, optional "N flagged for review" line | `:721-770` |
| `_AnalyticsBand` → "Candidates per assessment" | `BarChart`, top 8 by candidate count, all bars `t.primary`. Rendered only when `load.first.value > 0` | `:721-728` |
| Panel "Cohort outcome" | `ScoreRing(passed, decided.length)` + KvRows Passed / Failed / Average score / Pass threshold | `:230-293` |
| Panel "Integrity flags" | 4 KvRows: Integrity alerts, Score outliers, Proctoring violations, Scoring errors, each a `_FlagMark` badge (`inert` at zero, `:689-698`) | `:294-319` |
| Panel "Performance by assessment" | `DataGrid`, minWidth 870 | `:322-402` |
| Panel "Leaderboard" | `DataGrid`, minWidth 620, top 10 | `:404-415`, `:430-493` |
| Panel "Recent submissions" | `DataGrid`, minWidth 760, newest 8 | `:417-422`, `:496-551` |

Columns:

| Table | Columns |
|---|---|
| Performance by assessment (`_PerformancePanel`) | Assessment (flex, link, row → `nav.assessment`), State (110, `Pill.state`), Starts (110, the scheduled start as an IST date only via `istShortDate`, `-` when never scheduled), Progress (156, `FunnelCell`), Avg score (92). Grid `minWidth` 630 (19.0.3.23.0: Starts was 96 wide and printed through `humanWhen`; with the IST time it needed 150 and pushed Avg score off a 1,440 px screen, N9/F1-03) |
| Leaderboard (`:464-469`) | Rank, Candidate, Sittings, Marks |
| Recent submissions (`:521-527`) | Candidate (link, row → `nav.attempt`), Assessment, Submitted, Result, Marks |

**AppStore methods called.** `visibleAssessments(portal)` `:55`; `attemptsFor(id)` `:61, 351, 438, 500, 644`; `releasable(a)` `:378`; `personById(id)` `:486, 531`. Nothing else - no mutation, no fetch, no hydration call.

**AppStore state read** (transitively): `assessments` (via `visibleAssessments`), `attempts` (via `attemptsFor` / `releasable`), `people` (via `personById`).

**Empty / loading / error.** No own loading or error branch. Empty is handled per-panel: "Cohort outcome" swaps to an `EmptyState` with a "Go to assessments" action when `decided.isEmpty` (`:233-245`); "Where the cohort stands" prints "Nobody is assigned yet." (`:658`); "Decided outcomes" prints a sentence (`:686-690`); the three `DataGrid`s each carry their own `emptyMessage` + `emptyIcon` (`:336-340`, `:459-463`, `:517-520`). None has an `emptyAction`.

#### 2. `assessment_list_screen.dart` (262 lines) - "Assessments"

**Purpose.** The list of every visible assessment. `StatefulWidget`; local state is `_search` and `_stateFilter` only (`:36-37`).

**What a user sees.** `PageHead` "Assessments" with `Btn.primary('New assessment')` shown only for `Portal.admin` (`:84-90`). A 5-tile `KpiStrip`: Assessments, Live now, Candidates assigned, Awaiting release, Blocked by scoring (`:92-111`). When any assessment has a scoring error, a `Tone.bad` `Notice` "N assessment(s) are held on pending." ending "Open the assessment to re-score it." - with NO button since 19.0.3.23.0: the org-wide "Re-score all" (`s.rescore(null)`) is gone, because the queue route refuses a call with no assessment (`missing_target`); recovery is per paper (`re_score_all_is_gone_test.dart`). Then one `Panel` with a toolbar (search field, state `SelectField` seeded from `AsmState.values`, a `TagChip` showing "N shown") over a `DataGrid` of minWidth 880.

Columns (`:185-201`): Assessment (link), State, Generator, Questions, Progress (`FunnelCell`), Awaiting, Duration. The whole row navigates (`:230`); there is deliberately no trailing Open button (`:250-252`).

The Questions cell has a three-step fallback (`:225-229`): `a.paperSize` (one candidate's draw, round 3, A-104) when questions are loaded, else `questionLimit` when > 0, else `questionsAvailable`.

**AppStore methods called.** `visibleAssessments(portal)` `:47`; `attemptsFor(id)` `:65, 74, 207`; `releasable(a)` `:69, 219`.

**Empty / loading / error.** Only the `DataGrid` empty state, and it forks on cause (`:159-184`): unfiltered → "No assessments yet…" with a `New assessment` action; filtered → "Nothing matches that search…" with a `Clear filters` action that resets both filters. No error branch.

#### 3. `assessment_detail_screen.dart` (1670 lines)

**Purpose.** The single record surface for one assessment. `StatefulWidget` holding `_tab` (from the route, default `config`) and `_rosterSearch` (`:62-63`). `initState` calls `store.loadAssessment(widget.asmId)` (`:64`) because the list row carries `candidate_count` but no `roster`.

**Tabs** (`:104-132`). A disabled tab stays visible; a deep link onto a disabled tab silently falls back to the first tab (`:133-136`).

| Key | Label | Badge count | Enabled when |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config` | Configuration | - | always |
| `assign` | Assign candidates | `evs.length` if any attempts exist, else `asm.roster.length` | `isDraft` |
| `candidates` | Candidates | `evs.length` | `!isDraft` |
| `leaderboard` | Leaderboard | - | `!isDraft` |
| `questions` | Selected questions | `asm.totalQuestions` | always (comment `:123-126` records that this was previously draft-disabled) |

**Header actions** (`_headerActions`, `:302-454`), in emission order:

| Button | Condition | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `Launch & invite` (primary) or `Launch & invite (N to fix)` (secondary) | `asm.state.isDraft && portal.can(Capability.launch)` | opens `_showLaunchSheet`. **Always pressable**; only the label and tone change with the failing-gate count (`:273-289`) |
| `Release results (N)` (primary) | `s.releasable(asm).length > 0 && portal.can(Capability.release)` | opens `_showReleaseSheet` |
| `Resend invitations` | `state == inProgress && portal.can(Capability.lifecycle)` | `s.resendInvites(asm)` |
| `Score All` | `!state.isDraft && canLifecycle`; **enabled** when `anyAwaiting` in ANY non-draft state (a done paper is where ungraded answers pile up) and **not** while `scoringPhase == stopping` | `s.queueScoringFor(assessmentId: asm.id)` -> `POST /scoring/queue` |
| `Score Failed Candidates (N)` (danger) | `!state.isDraft && canLifecycle && N > 0 && state != cancelled`; disabled while `stopping` | `s.requeueFailedFor(assessmentId: asm.id)` -> `POST /scoring/requeue_errored {states: ['failed','error']}`; the toast counts `answers_reset`. Rendered only when N > 0, per the house rule that an always-on button reporting "nothing is errored" reads as a broken button. Not offered on a `cancelled` assessment, because it spends LLM calls |
| `Kill Scoring Process` (danger outline) | `!state.isDraft && canLifecycle` and the server's `scoringPhase.isStoppable` (the attempts cache only when the server sends no phase) | `_showKillScoringSheet` -> `POST /assessments/<id>/kill_scoring`. The sheet states that stored scores are kept and that the LLM call already in flight still completes and is billed, and (19.0.3.23.0) that "Individual answers queued with "Re-score" are dropped too. They keep their current marks, and re-scoring them again is the way back." The toast reads `settled_count`, `cleared_count` and `held_count` (see 3.2 Scoring) |
| `Mark done` | same | `s.markDone(asm)` directly when no attempt is `inProgress`; otherwise a confirmation sheet naming the live count with `Leave it open` / `Close it anyway` (`:306-357`) |
| `Reset to draft` | `state == cancelled && canLifecycle` | `_resetToDraft` -> `s.resetToDraft(asm)`; when the server answers 409 `released_results` a sheet "Erase released results?" shows its sentence: "Erase and Reset" retries with `confirmReleased: true`, "Keep Results" changes nothing (round 3, A-040) |
| `Cancel` (danger) | `state != cancelled && state != done && canLifecycle` (hidden on a Done paper since round 3, L-246: `action_cancel` refuses `done`) | `s.cancel(asm)` |
| `Export roster` | always; disabled when `attemptsFor(asm.id).isEmpty` | client-side CSV via `buildCsv`/`downloadCsv` (`:408-436`) |
| `Export responses` | `!state.isDraft`; disabled when `asm.submittedCount == 0` | `s.exportResponses(asm)` |
| `Export results` | `!state.isDraft`; disabled when `asm.submittedCount == 0` | `s.exportResults(asm)` |

Between the head and the tab strip: a `StatusBar(asm.state)`; a `Tone.bad` scoring-error `Notice` ("N candidates held on a scoring error.") with a "Re-score This Assessment" button when any attempt has one - hidden on a cancelled paper (R7-01) and disabled while a Kill is stopping (S1); it calls `s.rescore(asm)`, which resets the failed and errored answers first and then queues (see 3.2 Scoring); since 19.0.3.23.0 a "Scored X/Y candidates on <Sep 21, 2026 at 10:04pm IST>" `Notice` (ok when X >= Y, else info) whenever the server sends `scoringScored > 0` and `scoringFinishedAt` - during a run it shows the tally saved when that run started, so it moves only when the run ends (row 20); and, on a draft with launch capability, a `Tone.warn` banner naming the **first two** failing gates plus a "See all checks" button (`:176-212`).

**The scoring watch** (19.0.3.23.0, row 23). While the server's phase is busy the screen reads `/api/v1/scoring` for this paper: every 5 s, backing off to 15 s after one unchanged answer and 30 s after two (the phase, summary, queued, needs-manual-requeue and stalled numbers are compared), and snapping back to 5 s on any change - about 4 reads a minute per open tab instead of 12. A hidden browser tab (`AppLifecycleState.hidden` / `paused`; a blur is not hidden) stops the timer and reads at once when shown again. A stalled queue is re-checked once a minute. The cap is 720 ticks. When a run ends the one full detail read is spread over a random 0-5 s (`AssessmentDetailScreen.runEndJitter`), so every tab open on the paper does not hit the heavy detail route in the same second. Test: `the_scoring_watch_backs_off_and_sleeps_in_a_hidden_tab_test.dart`.

**Launch gates.** `store.launchGates(asm)` → `Gates.launch` (`lib/assessment/domain/gates.dart::launch`), which always returns **seven** results and never short-circuits:

| # | Gate | Passes when |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | The assessment is a draft | `asm.state.isDraft` |
| 2 | At least one candidate is assigned | attempts for this assessment, **or** `asm.roster.length` when there are none yet (`gates.dart:54-56`) |
| 3 | A question generator is selected | `genById(asm.generatorId) != null` |
| 4 | The generator has usable questions | bank contains ≥1 `launchReady` question with `genId == asm.generatorId` |
| 5 | The requested question count is available | `want > 0 && asm.questions.length >= want`, where `want = questionLimit > 0 ? questionLimit : questions.length` |
| 6 | Every objective question has an answer key | no selected objective question fails `hasCompleteKey`; names up to 10 offenders |
| 7 | Every subjective question has a signed-off rubric | passes trivially unless `asm.requireReviewedRubric` |

`_showLaunchSheet` (`:441-480`) renders `CheckList(gates)` plus, when the dry run answers, the server's amber warning rows (`launchWarnings`, e.g. the questions that will be graded with no usable answer key), adds a green "Ready to launch" notice with the invitation count when all pass, and enables `Launch & invite` only when `Gates.allPass`. On confirm it pops, calls `s.launch(asm)`, and switches `_tab` to `candidates`. `AppStore.launch` re-checks the gates before calling the API and refuses with a toast if any fail (`app_store.dart:1145-1150`).

`_showReleaseSheet` (`:488-566`): a 3-tile KPI strip (Submitted / Releasing now / Still grading), a warning listing **each** still-grading candidate by name with their unresolved count and a "(scoring error)" suffix, a "This cannot be undone" `Tone.bad` notice, then three actions - `Cancel`, `Wait for scoring` (pops + info toast, writes nothing), and `Release N result(s)` which calls `s.releaseResults(asm)` and is disabled when `targets.isEmpty`.

**Tab contents.**

- `_ConfigTab` (`:1581-1914`). **THREE gates, not one, and this is the fix that made the tab honest.** `_ro = !store.can(Capability.configure)` (`:1596`) is capability only - by a product decision of 2026-08-18 an operator may still correct configuration on a running assessment - and it renders the inert "Read-only. Configuration is an authoring capability." `Notice`. `_drawRo = _ro || !asm.state.isDraft` (`:1604`) locks what launch draws - Shuffle Questions and the Questions count - and `_scoreRo = _ro || state == done || state == cancelled` (`:1614`) locks automatic grading. Until 19.0.3.22.0 every switch was behind `_ro` alone, so the draw settings were editable in every state while the server refused them: `shuffle_questions` is folded into `preserve_question_order` by `_apply_shuffle_alias` BEFORE the draft gate, so toggling it on a running assessment moved a switch on screen and came back a silent 409. `FieldGrid`: Name, Generator (falls back to "Not set"), Project (`asm.projectId ?? 'Not tagged'`) read-only; Duration a live `NumberField` unless `_ro`; Questions a live `NumberField` on a draft and, since 19.0.3.23.0, read-only behind `_drawRo` once launched (launch draws ONE shared set and late candidates copy it, so a changed count would reach nobody; the server refuses it with 422 `locked_after_launch`, row 35). Both forms show one value, `questionLimit` when set else `effectiveQuestionCount`, so launching does not change the number on screen; Pass threshold (%) a live `NumberField` (1-100) editable even after Done (Q20): it shows the effective value from the payload - an assessment made before Q20 shows its subjective threshold - and a change sends `pass_threshold` alone, then adopts the server's value; Subjective threshold a live `NumberField` editable even after Done. Both threshold fields set `commitOnSubmit`, because each save re-decides the paper's results: a typed value is saved once, on Enter or on leaving the field (typing 65 sends one update, not 6 then 65). A typed value outside the range is not clamped: it is refused with `<value> is not allowed: enter 1 to 100.` (`0 to 100` for the subjective threshold), announced as a live region, and the field goes back to the saved value; the message clears when the field is edited again or its value changes. The +/- buttons still save at once. Every other stepper here still saves on each keystroke, clamped. Optional `thresholdRecomputePending` info notice. Then TWO `SwitchRow`s under "Scoring", in the order the Odoo form repeats - Shuffle Questions (`_drawRo`, ON by default, the client-side name for the server's inverse `preserve_question_order`) and Grade subjective answers automatically (`_scoreRo`); there is no "Same questions for everybody" switch any more, because everybody always gets the same questions (decided 2026-09-22, removed from both consoles in 19.0.3.23.0, row 34) - followed, only when the assessment is past draft AND the toggle is on, by an info `Notice` saying it applies from the next submission onwards and pointing at Re-score to sweep in those who already submitted (`action_llm_score_all`, `/scoring/queue`, which ignores the flag). "Require a reviewed rubric", "Blend justification into image A/B" and "Require a justification on objective answers" are NOT on this surface any more. Then one `SwitchRow` per `ProctorRule` under "Rules and Proctoring" (`:1887-1902`), On violation and Threshold (0-20; read-only it shows the cap, or 0 as "First Violation" under Auto-submit and "No Limit" under Log only; round 3), closing with a violation-policy `Notice` from `violationConsequence` (Log only never ends the exam at any cap - reaching it only marks the attempt as over the limit - and Auto-submit ends it at the cap; round 3, A-074). The On violation help states the same rule: "Auto-submit ends the exam at the threshold, and a threshold of 0 ends it on the first violation. Log only never ends the exam: reaching the threshold only marks the attempt as over the violation limit." Every switch writes through `store.updateAsm(asm.copyWith(...))`.
- `_AssignTab` (`:779-897`). Chips for each assigned attempt (removable) plus chips for `asm.roster` members with no attempt yet (`onRemove: null`, `:2560-2562`), or "Nobody is assigned yet." A search field, then `Invite by email` (`_showInviteSheet` → `store.inviteByEmail`), `Import from CSV` (`_showRosterSheet` → `_CsvImportBody`, a real file picker + parser → `store.inviteMany`, `:2522-2649`), and `Download template` (`store.downloadCandidateTemplate`). A `DataGrid` of people: Name, Email, Pod, and an Assign/Remove button calling `store.toggleAssign`.
- `_CandidatesTab` (`:1179-1267`). `DataGrid` minWidth 1180, columns: Candidate (link), Invite (`Pill.state` + a tooltip icon carrying `e.inviteError` + a Resend button, both only when `inviteState == failed`), State, Answered, Score (`Marks(earnedMarks, maxMarks)`), Result, Released (`Released`/`Held` pill), Flags (`Scoring error`, `Integrity`, `Outlier`, `Auto`, `Erased` badges). Row → `nav.attempt`. The roster is fetched server-side one page at a time (search, filter and order included). **State chips (19.0.3.23.0, row 33):** `All`, one chip per `AttemptState`, then `Scored` and `Score Pending` (`ScoringFilter`), which split Submitted by its answers (Scored = no answer that needs the grader is unscored; the two add up to Submitted). Every chip's number comes from the roster route's `meta.counts` (`store.rosterCountsFor(asm.id)`), not from the console-wide attempts cache, which a finished run does not refresh and which cannot make the split; the tab refetches when a run ends. A chip at 0 is hidden unless it is the pressed one, so an applied filter can always be undone; a server that sends no counts gets the chips without numbers. Both chip groups send their wire in the route's `state` parameter. Tests: `the_roster_chips_count_from_the_roster_route_test.dart`, `a_pressed_chip_stays_while_its_filter_is_applied_test.dart`.
- `_LeaderboardTab` (`:1271-1359`). Released attempts only, sorted by `earnedMarks` descending. Each row: rank, name, optional `_SplitChips` (objective / subjective split, "N awaiting", "Scoring error"), `ThresholdBar`, `Marks`, result pill. Empty → `EmptyLine`.
- `_QuestionsTab` (`:1413-1442`). `DataGrid`: Question, Type, Difficulty, Key (`Complete`/`Missing`). Row → `showQuestionPreview`, which hydrates via `loadDraft` or `loadQuestion` **before** opening the sheet (`:1448-1469`), then renders the candidate view read-only with an answer-key panel, quality warnings, an Edit button (live mode only), and type-conditional media actions - `Detect now` / `Capture URL` for `imageLabel`/`imageLabel2`, `Upload clip` for `videoPrompt`.

**AppStore methods called.** `loadAssessment` `:64`; `asmById` `:1137`; `isHydrating('assessment', id)` `:79`; `attemptsFor` `:97, 310, 373, 375, 444, 492, 794, 1192, 1287`; `releasable` `:99, 489`; `launchGates` `:180, 274, 442`; `launchWarnings` (launch sheet); `rosterCountsFor` (Candidates chips); `killScoring` (Kill sheet); `rescore(asm)` `:163`; `resendInvites`, `markDone`, `resetToDraft`, `cancel` `:2345-2408`; `exportResponses`, `exportResults` `:388, 396`; `personById` `:421, 522, 815, 1212, 1324`; `toaster.ok` / `toaster.info` `:435, 552`; `updateAsm` (all Config switches); `toggleAssign` `:816, 889`; `downloadCandidateTemplate` `:862`; `inviteByEmail` `:943`; `inviteMany` `:1092`; `requeueInvite` `:1236`; `loadDraft` / `loadQuestion` `:1460-1462`; `anyQuestionById` `:2227`; `isLive` `:1499`; `detectNow` `:3868`; `captureUrl` `:1658`; `applyVideo` `:3879`; `people` (field, `:798`).

**Empty / loading / error.** `isHydrating('assessment', id)` → `DetailScreenSkeleton`; not hydrating and no record → "Assessment not found / It may have been removed." (`:75-95`). Per-tab empties: "Nobody is assigned yet.", "Nobody matches that search.", "Nobody was assigned to this assessment.", "Nothing to rank yet…", "No questions were selected for this assessment."

#### 4. `new_assessment_screen.dart` (459 lines)

**Purpose.** Compose a draft, running the *authoring* checks (`Gates.draftChecks`, five results) live as the form is filled.

**What a user sees.** Breadcrumbs (neither crumb has a tap handler, `:98-101`), `PageHead`, then a two-column layout. Left column, four panels:

| Panel | Fields |
|---|---|
| Name and source | Name `TextField`; Generator `SelectField` (from `s.generators`, resets `_picked` and clamps `_limit` to the pool size on change); Project `SelectField` |
| Questions | `Draw automatically` / `Choose by hand` toggle. Auto → a `NumberField` capped at pool size. Manual → a checkable `DataGrid` (checkbox, Question, Type, Difficulty). Below either, one `TagChip` per `QType` present in the selection |
| Schedule and Scoring | Duration (0-600), Pass threshold (1-100; starts at Settings' `scoring.default_pass_threshold`, 70 when missing or outside 1-100, and is sent as `pass_threshold` - see item 2 below), Subjective threshold (0-100), `Shuffle Questions` (ON by default). The `Same questions for everybody` switch was removed in 19.0.3.23.0 (everybody always gets the same questions; `create` no longer sends the key) |
| Rules and Proctoring | one `SwitchRow` per `ProctorRule` (**`Require webcam` defaults ON**), `On violation` select (Log only by default), `Threshold` (1-20, default 5 since round 3, A-074; was 3; help: "The violation count that marks the attempt Violation Limit Breached in both modes, and ends the exam under Auto-submit only."), and a consequence `Notice`. A draft created here now ships `llm_auto_score: false` - nothing is graded until an operator asks for it |

Right column: "Readiness" panel with `CheckList(checks)` and a full-width `Create draft` button, enabled only when `Gates.allPass` (`:399`), plus an explanatory line.

The auto-draw pool is `store.poolFor(generatorId)` - approved, launch-ready questions only (`:62-64`, `app_store.dart::poolFor`), which is what keeps the launch gates from failing on a question the author never chose.

**AppStore methods called.** `poolFor(genId)` `:64, 137`; `genById` `:83, 422`; `generators` (field) `:142`; `addAssessment(Assessment)` `:2860`.

**Empty / loading / error.** Only the manual-pick `DataGrid` empty message, which forks on whether a generator has been chosen (`:206-209`). No loading state, no hydration, no error branch - `addAssessment` reports failure through the store's toaster and returns null, and the screen just returns (`:453`). On success it navigates to `nav.assessment(created, tab: 'assign')` using the **server's** id.

#### 5. `attempt_detail_screen.dart` (792 lines)

**Purpose.** One candidate's attempt: result, session facts, per-answer marking.

`initState` calls `store.loadAttempt(widget.attemptId)` (`:52`); `_loadAttempt` also pulls the assessment behind it when it is missing (`app_store.dart:1842-1844`).

**What a user sees.** Breadcrumbs (Assessments → assessment → candidate). `PageHead` with the candidate name, then the assessment name on its own line and the email with its copy button on the next (19.0.3.23.0, row 46: the button always sits right after the address instead of wherever a long assessment name ends).

Header actions (`:101-143`):

| Button | Condition | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `Copy candidate link` | disabled when `ev.token.isEmpty` | writes `ev.candidateLink` to the clipboard, then an ok toast |
| `Re-score N answer(s)` (danger) | `toQueue.isNotEmpty && can(lifecycle)`, where `toQueue` = the unresolved answers not already `rescoreRequested`; disabled while the paper's `scoringPhase == stopping` | `rescoreConfirmed(context, store, {ev.id: toQueue})` - exactly those answers, asking first on a released result (see 3.9 `rescore_sheet.dart`). The label's count IS the request |
| `Re-score queued` (danger, always disabled) | nothing left to ask for but `ev.hasQueuedRescore` | none. Says the grader has been asked and the page re-reads itself until it lands |
| `Export responses` | `ev.isDone` | `store.exportAttemptResponses(ev.id)` |
| `Release this result` (primary) | `ev.isDone && !ev.resultsReleased && portal.can(Capability.release)` | `store.releaseOne(ev.id)` |
| `Erase candidate data` (danger) | `!ev.piiAnonymized && portal.can(Capability.lifecycle)` | opens the erase sheet (`:397-478`) |

Then the stacked `Notice` banners, ordered "blocking before annotating" (`:148-208`): PII erased (inert), grader error (bad, with a "Reset and re-score" action that sends the unresolved answer ids through `rescoreConfirmed`, or no ids when the answers have not loaded, and is disabled while stopping), since 19.0.3.23.0 **the grader's reason** (warn, `graderReasonNotice`: "The grader left a reason on this candidate." plus `subjectiveError` verbatim - a failed re-score that kept its mark, or a call deferred for a spend cap or a 429 with no attempt used; both otherwise read as a plain "Pending"), score outlier (warn), integrity signal (warn), a red "Violation Limit Breached - N / cap" badge (`ViolationBreachBadge`) when `ev.limitBreached(asm)` (the violation limit reached, in either mode: under Log only the paper was not ended, under Auto-submit it ended there; round 3, A-074), proctoring violations (warn, listing EVERY violation with its frequency - "6 proctoring violations recorded. Right-click attempted (x3), Tab switched/window hidden (x2), Clipboard action: copy (x1)." - and whether it auto-submitted; falls back to naming `violationReason` alone for an attempt recorded before the server kept a log).

Two panels side by side: **Result** - `ScoreRing`, result pill, `Released`/`Held` pill, `Marks`, `ThresholdBar` against `asm.passThreshold`, a sentence that switches to the unresolved count when there is one, and a 5-tile `AutoGrid` (Answered as `answeredCount / ev.paperSize(asm)` - this candidate's draw: the row's `serverQuestions`, else the paper size, not the pool, round 3, A-104 - Violations, Unresolved, Auto-submitted, State) - and **Session** - Attempt id, Invitation, Started, Submitted, Locked, Candidate link (a `LinkBtn` reading `/exam/<token>` that navigates in-app).

Then "Score details", a `DataGrid` of minWidth 900 over the questions that have a response (`:338-340`): Question, Type, Scoring (`Pill.state(r.llmState)`, or an info `Re-score queued` pill while `r.rescoreRequested` - the state alone would show a queued re-score of a SCORED answer as untouched), Raw (`llmRaw100` or `-`), Mark, and an `Audit` button when `r.judge != null`. Row → `nav.response(ev.id, q.id)`. The Audit sheet (`showAuditSheet`) no longer has a "Judge prompt" field (19.0.3.23.0, row 48). Session dates print through `istTimestamp`.

**The queued watch (19.0.3.23.0, row 26).** The rescore route only queues, so while `hasQueuedRescore` holds (live mode) the screen re-reads the attempt (`loadAttempt`) every 10 s, stopping the moment nothing is queued and after at most 360 ticks (an hour); it re-arms on the store's notify. No hidden-tab pause (deferred, G1-05). Test: `the_candidate_page_shows_a_queued_re_score_test.dart`.

There is deliberately no chatter panel (`:380-383`).

**The release action, exactly.** `Btn.primary('Release this result')` → `store.releaseOne(ev.id)` (`app_store.dart::releaseOne`):

1. Looks up the attempt; returns silently if absent.
2. **Local gate**: if the owning assessment is loaded and `a.unresolvedQuestionIds(asm).isNotEmpty`, it refuses with a warn toast and sends nothing (`:1313-1320`).
3. Otherwise `_act('Release', () => _api.release(a.assessmentId, evaluatorIds: <String>[a.id]))`.
4. On the wire: `POST /api/v1/assessments/<assessmentId>/release` with body `{"evaluator_ids": ["<attemptId>"]}` (`data/api_client.dart:594-599`). `evaluator_ids` is omitted entirely when the list is empty, which is what the bulk release does.
5. Optimistic local `resultsReleased: true`; success toast "Result released"; a background `refresh()` in the `finally` re-reads the server's truth. When the server skipped the candidate because a grading lane holds it (`released_count: 0`, `skipped_count > 0`), the optimistic flag is undone and the toast is the warning "Not released - this candidate is still being graded" (19.0.3.23.0, G1-23).

The in-code comment at `app_store.dart:1324-1336` records that this call previously sent no `evaluatorIds`, and that the route treats an empty list as "release the whole submitted cohort" - so a per-candidate button published every candidate's score. The single-id form is the fix.

**AppStore methods called.** `loadAttempt` `:52`; `attemptById` `:1137`; `isHydrating('attempt', id)` `:67`; `asmById` `:77`; `personById` `:1795`; `toaster.ok` `:115`; `rescoreAnswers` (through `rescoreConfirmed`); `loadAttempt` again from the queued watch; `exportAttemptResponses` `:129`; `releaseOne` `:136`; `erasePii` `:3778`.

**Empty / loading / error.** Hydrating and no attempt → `DetailScreenSkeleton`; not hydrating and no attempt → "Attempt not found / It may have been removed." (`:66-76`). Attempt present but assessment missing → "Assessment not found" with **no** skeleton branch and no hydration retry (`:78-85`). Score details empty → "This candidate has not answered anything yet."

#### 6. `responses_screen.dart` (520 lines) - "All responses"

**Purpose.** Every answer across every assessment, in one auditable list. `StatefulWidget` with `_search`, `_asmFilter`, `_typeFilter`, `_stateFilter`, `_flag`, `_page`, `_pageSize`, and `_selected` keyed `attemptId|questionId` (`:51-64`).

**What a user sees.** `PageHead` with `Reset & re-score errored (N)` (danger, rendered only when `errored > 0`; since round 3, RV4-01, N and the request leave out answers on a cancelled paper, and the toast adds ", skipped N candidate(s) on cancelled or stopping papers" from the reply's `skipped`) and `Export CSV` (disabled on an empty result set). A 5-tile `KpiStrip`: Answers, Subjective, Unresolved, Terminal errors, Gated by integrity (`:165-196`). A `Tone.bad` `Notice` when `errored > 0` (`:200-218`) - with no button since 19.0.3.23.0; "Reset & re-score errored (N)" in the head is the recovery, and the org-wide "Re-score All" (`rescore(null)`) is gone. Then one `Panel` with a toolbar of five controls - search, assessment select, type select (`QType.values`), scoring-state select (`LlmState.values`), and a `_Flag` select whose four options are `No flag filter` / `Unresolved` / `Integrity gated` / `Scored zero` (`:29-39`) - plus a conditional `Re-score N selected` button and a "N of M" `TagChip`. A `Pagination` footer drives `_page` / `_pageSize`.

Columns (`:305-321`): a selection checkbox; Candidate (name + `Anonymized` badge + assessment name beneath); Question (name + type badge); Answer (`redactFor(ev, answerSummary(q, r))`, 2 lines; a list row carries no text, so a written answer shows the row's `justification_preview`, "Left blank" only when that is empty, and "-" from a server too old to send it - round 3, MT2FA-02); Mark (`Marks(score, 1)` + a `raw NN` line when `llmRaw100 != null`); Scoring (`Pill.state`, or an info `Re-score queued` pill while `r.rescoreRequested`, + `gateBadge` when gated); and an `Audit` button when `r.judge != null`. Row → `nav.response`.

**`Re-score N selected`** (19.0.3.23.0, row 26) grades EXACTLY the ticked answers: `_rescoreSelected` groups the ticked rows by attempt (dropping any answer whose `needsGrader` is false - an MCQ/MSQ is scored in code) and hands `{attemptId: [questionIds]}` to `rescoreConfirmed`, which asks first when any chosen attempt is released and then sends one request per candidate with one toast for the press. Nothing LLM-graded ticked → the info toast "None of the ticked answers is LLM-graded". Before, it de-duplicated to attempt ids and re-scored each candidate's UNRESOLVED answers instead of the ticked ones. The buttons here are not disabled while a paper is stopping; the server answers 409 `stopping` (known leftover, `ETP_PLANS_AND_STRATEGY.md` Part 0 §0.2 E). Tests: `a_re_score_grades_exactly_the_chosen_answers_test.dart`, `re_score_selected_says_so_once_test.dart`.

**AppStore methods called.** `allResponses()` `:109`; `personById` `:113, 325, 470`; `scoringErrorCount` `:123`; `requeueErrored()` `:157`; `rescoreAnswers` (through `rescoreConfirmed`); `assessments` (field) `:238`; `toaster.ok` `:485`.

`allResponses()` prefers the server's flattened `/api/v1/responses` rows and only falls back to the client-side attempt×question join when `responseRows` is empty (`app_store.dart::allResponses`).

**Empty / loading / error.** Only the `DataGrid` empty state, forked on `_isFiltered` (`:299-303, 439-444`). No error branch of its own.

#### 7. `response_detail_screen.dart` (767 lines)

**Purpose.** One answer as a linkable, citable route, so a mark can be defended.

`initState` calls `store.loadResponse(attemptId, questionId)` (`:48`) because the `/responses` list row omits `lines`, `subscores` and `justification`.

**What a user sees.** Breadcrumbs (Admin / All responses / "who question", none clickable). `PageHead` with the question name and `who · assessment · type`, plus two actions: `Open attempt`, and `Re-score` (danger). Since 19.0.3.23.0 (rows 25-27) `Re-score` is offered on ANY answer the grader marks (`r.needsGrader`) on a submitted attempt, scored ones included - a doubted mark is the commonest reason to re-grade - never on an MCQ/MSQ, and only with `Capability.lifecycle`. It re-scores this one answer (`rescoreConfirmed({ev.id: [questionId]})`), asks first on a released result, reads `Re-score queued` and is disabled while `r.rescoreRequested`, and is disabled while the paper is stopping. Tooltip: one LLM call; the mark is replaced only when the new grade succeeds. Below the head, `graderReasonNotice(ev)` (warn) shows the grader's last reason on this candidate, then a `Tone.bad` `Notice` with its own `Re-score` button when `llmState == error` (`:121-138`).

**The re-score watch (19.0.3.23.0).** While this answer reads `Re-score queued` the screen polls the light `/api/v1/scoring` counters for its paper every 10 s and re-reads the answer (`loadResponse`) only when the numbers move or the run is no longer busy; it stops when the label clears and after 360 ticks. No hidden-tab pause (deferred, G1-06). Test: `re_score_queued_clears_when_the_mark_lands_test.dart`.

Two columns:

| Panel | Contents |
|---|---|
| `_QuestionPanel` (`:200-257`) | head actions `Marks(r.score, 1)` + `Pill.state(r.llmState)`; prompt, description, "Candidate answer" box (redacted when anonymized), and "Correct answer" **only for objective types** |
| `_AuditPanel` (`:431-489`), rendered only when `r.judge != null` | "Open full audit" button; verdict `Notice`; a redaction notice when anonymized; KvRows Profile, Gate, Key closeness, SOP coverage, Subjective raw, Clarity, Rubric source, Judge model, Grader attempts (the "Judge prompt" row was removed in 19.0.3.23.0: an opaque hash an admin cannot act on) |
| `_AttemptPanel` (right, `:506-557`) | Candidate, Assessment, Attempt state, Result, Marks so far, Released (`Released`/`Held`), Unresolved answers, Violations (the count, or the red "Violation Limit Breached - N / cap" badge when breached, round 3), PII (`Anonymized` badge or "Retained"), plus a full-width "Open the full attempt" button |

The file also owns the shared helpers used by All responses: `showAuditSheet` (`:343-362`), `answerSummary` (`:717`), `correctSummary` (`:738`), `redactFor` (`:750`), `gateBadge` (`:755`), `isGated` (`:1132`), `pct` (`:767`). The audit sheet body carries a badge row, verdict notice, three weighted `_Meter`s (Key closeness 0.60, SOP coverage 0.25, Subjective raw against the threshold), four status badges, the candidate answer, deductions, credit, golden claims, and a `_Disclosure` folding away the reference answer, the scoring reasoning and the scored hash.

**AppStore methods called.** `loadResponse` `:48`; `attemptById` `:59`; `asmById` `:62`; `isHydrating('response', '$attemptId/$questionId')` `:71`; `personById` `:92`; `rescoreAnswers` (through `rescoreConfirmed`); `loadScoring` and `loadResponse` from the re-score watch. The file also exports `graderReasonNotice`, which `attempt_detail_screen.dart` imports.

**Empty / loading / error.** One combined guard: if any of attempt / assessment / question / response is null, show `DetailScreenSkeleton` while hydrating, otherwise "Response not found" with a sentence telling the reader to go back to All responses (`:70-90`).
