### The dashboard: client-side arithmetic vs server aggregates

**There is no server aggregate call on this screen, and none anywhere in the app.** `ApiClient` has no method for `/api/v1/analytics` at all - the only match for that path in the whole module is the comment at `dashboard_screen.dart:3`. `ApiClient.leaderboard()` (`data/api_client.dart:817`) and `ApiClient.myAnalytics()` (`:826`) exist but have **zero call sites** (verified by grep across `lib/assessment/`). Every figure on the dashboard is computed in `build()` from `store.assessments`, `store.attempts` and `store.people`, which `_loadAdmin` / `_loadAttempts` fetched as plain paged lists (`app_store.dart::_loadAttempts`, `:429-462`).

The one thing that is *not* recomputed is a set of per-assessment counters the list route sends on each `Assessment` row. They are used with a `-1`-means-absent sentinel and a client-side fallback:

| Figure | Source | Where |
|---|---|---|
| Assessments (KPI) | `visibleAssessments(portal).length` - client | `:55, 164` |
| **Candidates (KPI)** | `a.assignedCount` when `>= 0`, else `attemptsFor(a.id).length` - **server counter preferred** | `:137-146` |
| Submitted (KPI) | count of loaded attempts where `e.isDone` - client. Does **not** consult `submittedCount` | `:64-66` |
| "% of assigned" sub-line | `submitted.length / everyone.length`, both from loaded attempts - client. Its denominator is **not** the Candidates tile above it | `:84-86, 178` |
| Pass rate, "$passed of $N decided" | client, from `_resultOf` per attempt | `:73-83` |
| Awaiting result | `submitted.length - decided.length` - client | `:79` |
| Needs a closer look | `integrity + outliers + violations + scoringErrors`, each a client count over loaded attempts. Note it can **double-count** one attempt carrying several flags | `:121-135` |
| Average score | mean of `e.internalPercent(a)` over decided - client | `:87-94` |
| Pass threshold (Cohort outcome) | mean of `a.passThreshold` across all assessments - client | `:100-106` |
| Cohort pass/fail verdict | client: `decided.isEmpty ? pending : (passed > 0 && passRate >= meanThreshold ? pass : fail)` | `:114-118` |
| Integrity flags panel (4 rows) | client counts over loaded attempts | `:121-134` |
| Funnel / donut / bar band | client, from the same lists | `:630-743` |
| Table: Progress → **assigned** | `a.assignedCount` when `>= 0`, else count - **server counter preferred** | `:352-354` |
| Table: Progress → **submitted** | `a.submittedCount` when `>= 0`, else count - **server counter preferred** | `:355-357` |
| Table: Progress → **released** | always `evs.where(resultsReleased).length` - client only. There is no `releasedCount` field on `Assessment` | `:358-360` |
| Table: Decided / Passed / Avg score | client | `:361-375` |
| Table: **Awaiting** | `a.releasableCount` when `>= 0`, else `s.releasable(a).length` - **server counter preferred** | `:376-378` |
| Leaderboard | client: grouped in `_leaderboard` over released attempts, ranked by combined ratio then earned marks, top 10 | `:430-455` |
| Recent submissions | client: flattened, sorted by `submittedAt` desc with nulls last, top 8 | `:496-513` |
| `_AnalyticsBand` "Candidates per assessment" | `a.assignedCount` with the same fallback - **server counter preferred** | `:641-647` |

So exactly four numbers on the screen can come from the server: `assignedCount`, `submittedCount`, `releasableCount` (per assessment row) and nothing else. Everything else is arithmetic over rows already in memory.

**Two consequences worth knowing, both visible in the code.**

1. **The KPI strip mixes the two sources.** "Candidates" prefers `assignedCount`; "Submitted" and its "% of assigned" sub-line count loaded attempts. If the server's counter and the loaded attempt set disagree, the tile and its neighbour's percentage disagree. `assessment_list_screen.dart:63-66` has the mirror-image problem: its "Candidates assigned" KPI counts `attemptsFor(...)` while the table row two inches below prefers `assignedCount`.

2. **`_resultOf` suppresses every decided result on a freshly-loaded console.** `_resultOf(a, e)` returns `pending` whenever `a.totalQuestions == 0` (`:588-589`), and `totalQuestions` is `questions.length` (`models.dart::totalQuestions`), which is empty on any assessment loaded from the list route - only `loadAssessment` hydrates questions, and only the detail screen calls it. So after a plain `refresh()` the Pass rate reads `-`, Cohort outcome shows its `EmptyState`, the Decided/Passed/Avg score columns read `0`/`0`/`-`, and `_leaderboard` skips every assessment outright (`:436`). This is conservative rather than wrong, but note that `Attempt.result` would work without the frozen questions when the server sent `result.score_marks`, since `internalPercent` divides by `serverTotal ?? asm.totalQuestions` (`models.dart:2152, 2162-2166`) - the `totalQuestions == 0` guard discards that path before it is reached. UNKNOWN: whether `/api/v1/attempts` actually sends `score_marks` on its list rows (the model comment at `models.dart:2069-2076` documents it for the *candidate* list only).

---

### Things that are decorative, stale, or contradictory

Named plainly, with evidence.

1. **New assessment → "Project" select is discarded.** The three options `P-1`, `P-2`, `P-4` are hardcoded in the widget (`new_assessment_screen.dart:156-161`), stored on the `Assessment` (`:434`), and then dropped: `AppStore.addAssessment` does not pass `projectId` to `_api.createAssessment` (`app_store.dart:1602-1624`), and `ApiClient.createAssessment` has no project parameter (`data/api_client.dart:1059-1101`). Live, choosing a project does nothing.

2. **RESOLVED (Q20 follow-up): New assessment → "Pass threshold (%)" is sent.** The stepper (`int? _pass`, null until the operator touches it) shows Settings' `scoring.default_pass_threshold` (70 when missing or outside 1-100, whole numbers), is bounded 1-100, and `AppStore.addAssessment` sends it as `pass_threshold`. Seen live: Settings default 83 shown; left alone the paper saved at 83, typed 55 saved at 55. It used to default to 60 (min 0) and was never sent, so the paper silently took the Settings default (`ETP_PLANS_AND_STRATEGY.md` Part 0 §0.3, option B). One gap: if `/settings` failed to load, the form shows and sends 70 rather than letting the server seed its own default.

3. **`Col('Pod')` on the Assign tab roster** (`assessment_detail_screen.dart:873`, value at `:884`). `Person.pod` is parsed from a `pod` key (`models.dart::pod`) and is populated by the seed fixtures (`state/seed_data.dart:66` etc.). The live `people` table is built from `row['candidate']` on `/api/v1/attempts` (`app_store.dart:452-458`). UNKNOWN: whether that candidate object carries `pod`. If it does not, this column renders an empty cell on every row against a real backend.

4. **The `Capability` enum is six values wide and one value deep.** `PortalCapabilities.can` returns `true` for every capability on `Portal.admin` and `false` for every one on `Portal.member` (`domain/enums.dart::can`). So `portal.can(Capability.launch)`, `.release`, `.lifecycle` and `.configure` throughout `assessment_detail_screen.dart` and `attempt_detail_screen.dart` are all the same test - "is this the admin portal". The distinctions the enum draws are not enforced anywhere.

5. **The Program Manager portal described at the top of the assessment list does not exist.** `assessment_list_screen.dart:1-6` says the screen serves "both the Admin and the Program Manager portal" and that "the PM sees only assessments tagged to a project they run". `Portal` has exactly two members, `admin` and `member` (`domain/enums.dart:634-636`), and `visibleAssessments` returns the full list for admin and an **empty list** for anything else (`app_store.dart::visibleAssessments`). There is no project-scoped filtering anywhere.

6. **Two different functions named `showAuditSheet`, with different content.** `attempt_detail_screen.dart:483` takes positional arguments and renders "Answer audit" (a 4-tile KPI strip: Mark / Raw / Threshold / Attempts; `FieldGrid` of Profile / Gate / Rubric source / Judge model; three `_Meter`s; an `ExpansionTile` disclosure). `response_detail_screen.dart:343` takes named arguments and renders "Scoring audit" (a badge `Wrap`; three `_Meter`s with different fill tokens; four threshold badges; a stateful `_Disclosure`). The Audit button on the attempt's Score details grid opens the first; the Audit button in All responses and the "Open full audit" button on Response detail open the second. Same claimed job, two implementations, two titles, two field sets.

7. **"Leaderboard" means two different rankings.** The dashboard ranks a *person* across every released sitting by combined ratio, tie-broken on earned marks (`dashboard_screen.dart:447-454`). The assessment detail's Leaderboard tab ranks *attempts within one assessment* by raw `earnedMarks` only (`assessment_detail_screen.dart:1290-1293`). Within one assessment the denominators match so the outcome is the same, but the two surfaces do not share a rule.

8. **The dashboard's Rank column trophy is presentation only.** `StatusBadge` with a trophy icon for `i < 3`, plain `Mono` otherwise (`dashboard_screen.dart:473-483`). A leaderboard row opens that person's My Performance page (`nav.candidatePerformance(applicantId)`, an admin-only route; round 3, A-133), where an admin viewing someone else sees held marks in the breakdown rows.

9. **`Col('Key')` on the Selected questions tab reads "Complete" for every subjective question.** Still true, re-verified for this edition, with the citations moved: `hasCompleteKey` returns `true` unconditionally for a non-objective type (`models.dart:1163-1164`), so "Complete" there means "not applicable", not "a rubric exists". A subjective question with no rubric at all still shows a green `Complete` pill (`assessment_detail_screen.dart:1914-1916`). What DID change in this cycle is the tab's neighbouring `Col('Type')`, which now prints `q.taskLabelLong` (`:1911`) rather than the engine type, so a Form Studio question names the control it was drawn as - see `designer_kind` in section 1.7. The Key column was not touched.

10. **Export responses / Export results gate on the wrong sentinel.** Both are disabled when `asm.submittedCount == 0` (`assessment_detail_screen.dart:386, 395`), but the field's "not sent" default is `-1` (`models.dart:1471`). When the server omits the counter both buttons stay enabled, including on an assessment with nothing submitted.

11. **FIXED - the roster CSV's `Answered` column.** It wrote the answer count over a marks total, later over the pool (`totalQuestions`); since round 3 (A-104) the CSV and the attempt's "Answered" KPI both write `'${ev.answeredCount} / ${ev.paperSize(asm)}'`, the candidate's own draw (`serverQuestions`, else the paper size). The adjacent `Score` column is still `ev.marksDisplay(asm)`, the marks fraction.

12. **"Copy candidate link" copies a path, not a URL.** `Attempt.candidateLink` is `'/exam/$token'` (`models.dart::candidateLink`). What lands on the clipboard is `/exam/tok-…`, which cannot be pasted into a mail client and opened. The toast still says "Candidate link copied" (`attempt_detail_screen.dart:109-116`).

13. **The Config tab's subjective-threshold field ignores the read-only gate.** STILL OPEN at 19.0.3.23.0 (re-checked; it was open at 19.0.3.22.0 too): the `NumberField` is now `assessment_detail_screen.dart:1910-1916` and still calls `store.updateAsm` unconditionally, while `_ro` is `:1767`, `_drawRo` `:1776` and `_scoreRo` `:1786`. The switches and the Questions count each carry a gate; this one control did not, so the "Read-only. Configuration is an authoring capability." notice still sits above a live field for an operator WITHOUT `Capability.configure`. Note the comment above the field (`:1745-1759`) no longer argues the lifecycle case - it explains the help text - so the surviving bypass has no rationale attached to it at all any more. **Code defect, not a docs defect: not fixed here.**

14. **Stale column-count comment.** `responses_screen.dart:307-314` says "ELEVEN columns became EIGHT"; the `cols` list that follows has **seven** entries (`:305-321`), and the rows emit seven widgets. The 322px fixed-width figure quoted in the same comment (34+92+132+64) is correct for seven.

15. **Dead client methods.** `ApiClient.leaderboard()` (`data/api_client.dart:817`) and `ApiClient.myAnalytics()` (`:826`) are never called. The dashboard's own comment at `:409-413` names `/api/v1/leaderboard` as the future replacement for its client-side ranking; the method to call it already exists and is unused.


## 3.6 Screens: generators, review queue, bank, tags, scoring

All paths below are relative to `ethara-assessment-fe/`.

#### 0. File map and shared mechanics

| File | Lines | Route class (`lib/assessment/nav.dart`) |
|---|---|---|
| `lib/assessment/screens/admin/generator_list_screen.dart` | 238 | `GeneratorList` (nav.dart::GeneratorList) |
| `lib/assessment/screens/admin/new_generator_screen.dart` | 244 | `NewGenerator` (nav.dart:55) |
| `lib/assessment/screens/admin/generator_detail_screen.dart` | 1528 | `GeneratorDetail` via `nav.generator(id, tab:)` (nav.dart::generator) |
| `lib/assessment/screens/admin/review_queue_screen.dart` | 1005 | `ReviewQueue` via `nav.review(gen:)` (nav.dart:65, 225) |
| `lib/assessment/screens/admin/bank_screen.dart` | 277 | bank route |
| `lib/assessment/screens/admin/tags_screen.dart` | 235 | `TagsAdmin` (nav.dart::TagsAdmin) |
| `lib/assessment/screens/admin/scoring_screen.dart` | 224 | `ScoringAdmin` (nav.dart:77) |
| `lib/assessment/widgets/question_editor.dart` | 384 | not a route - two sheet entry points |

Conventions every screen in this directory follows:

- All read state through `AppStore` (a `ChangeNotifier`) wrapped in `ListenableBuilder`. `tags_screen.dart` is the only `StatelessWidget` of the seven (tags_screen.dart:21).
- Root destinations (`generator_list`, `review_queue`, `bank`, `tags`) deliberately render **no** breadcrumb; the shell prints "Admin / <page>" (generator_list_screen.dart:63-65, review_queue_screen.dart:195-197, bank_screen.dart:65-67, tags_screen.dart:52-55). `new_generator` and `generator_detail` do render `Crumbs`.
- `store.isLive` (app_store.dart::isLive) is `source == DataSource.live`. Many controls are disabled or hidden when false. `store.isBusy(key)` (app_store.dart::isBusy) drives per-action spinners.
- Nearly every write goes through `AppStore._act` (app_store.dart::_act), which in seed mode calls `ifSeed` and returns, and in live mode always runs `refresh(background: true)` in a `finally`.

---

#### 1. `generator_list_screen.dart` - Generators

**Purpose.** One row per generator (one per SOP), with generation state, draft backlog, and duplicate flagging.

**Layout.** `PageBody` → `PageHead` → `KpiStrip` (5 KPIs) → conditional duplicate `Notice` → `Panel(flush: true)` with a `Toolbar` and a `DataGrid`.

| Control | Behaviour | Store call |
|---|---|---|
| `Btn.primary('New generator')` header (:72-77) | `context.nav.go(const NewGenerator())` | - |
| `SearchField` (:131-135) | local `_search`; filters on `g.name` and joined `g.tags` (:43-47) | - |
| `TagChip('n of m')` (:137) | display only | - |
| Empty-state action (:151-162) | when unsearched: New generator. When searched: `Clear search` | - |
| Row `onTap` (:229) | `context.nav.generator(g.id)` | - |

KPIs and their sources: `all.length`; `sum(g.questionCount)` (:49-52); `s.pendingDrafts().length` (:53); `s.jobs.where(running).length` (:54-56); `all.where(g.possibleDuplicate).length` (:57-59).

Columns: `Generator` (name + "Possible duplicate" badge), `SOP` (`g.sopFile`), `Generation` (`Pill.state(g.sopGenState)`), `Questions` (`g.questionCount`, `-` at 0), `Drafts` (`s.pendingDrafts(g.id).length`), `Tags` (first 3 + `+n`), `Owner` (owner stacked over the generator's created stamp, an IST timestamp since 19.0.3.23.0; the column went 112 → 128 so the zone is not clipped, and the grid `minWidth` 1150 → 1166). The action column is 136 px, room for Archive/Restore plus the round-3 Delete icon, so Delete is not clipped at 1440 px. The comment at :170-176 says Owner and Updated were merged to keep the table inside the 996px content area.

**AppStore surface used:** `s.generators`, `s.pendingDrafts([genId])`, `s.jobs`. **Row actions** (round 3, A-092): Archive (live row) or Restore (archived row), and a Delete icon on every row that runs the bulk bar's own `_delete` - `store.previewGeneratorDelete`, then `confirmDelete` with the server's counts, then `deleteGenerators`: a generator no assessment uses is erased with its drafts and SOP files, a used one is archived and keeps its questions. A row Delete drops only that row from the selection.

**Notes.**
- `Jobs running` is always `0` against a live server. `jobs` is populated only from `SeedData` (app_store.dart:660) and cleared on live load (app_store.dart:509); there is no `Job.fromJson` anywhere in `lib/`.
- The list applies no `active` filter (:43-47), while the detail screen tells the operator an archived generator "no longer appears in the default list" (generator_detail_screen.dart:172-177). Whether archived rows are excluded depends entirely on `/api/v1/generators`. UNKNOWN: whether that route filters `active`.
- `Questions generated` sums across archived generators too.

**Layout.** `Crumbs` → `PageHead` (with Cancel / Create in `actions`) → single `Panel('The document')` containing Name field, SOP file field, and an informational `Notice`.

#### 4. `review_queue_screen.dart` - Review queue

**Purpose.** The human approval gate. The file's own header states two invariants: every decision goes through `store.decideDraft`, and a non-null return from it means the approval was refused and the preview must be forced open (:1-13).

##### 4a. The draft review flow

1. `initState` (:63-76): if `focusDraftId` is set, `_idx` is moved to that draft; a post-frame callback requests focus on `_keys` and calls `_hydrateCurrent`.
2. `_list()` (:109-111) = `store.pendingDrafts()` or `store.pendingDrafts(_gen)` - drafts only (`state == DraftState.draft`, app_store.dart::pendingDrafts).
3. `_hydrateCurrent` (:90-97) calls `store.loadDraft(d.id)` for the current card, skipped when `d.images.isNotEmpty` (used as the "already full" marker). Deliberately per-card, because images are inline base64 data URLs (:86-89).
4. `_clamped` (:115-116) clamps the index against a list that shrinks under it after each decision.
5. `_decide` (:126-142) is the single decision path. On refusal it opens the preview and returns; on success it re-clamps and schedules another hydrate.

**Keyboard (`_onKey`, :144-165).** `J` next, `K` previous, `A` approve, `D` deny, `U` undo. Shortcuts live on `_keys`, so a focused text field steals them (:58-61). The legend is printed at :363-366.

**Controls.**

| Control | Where | Store method |
|---|---|---|
| `Import CSV / JSON` | 204-208 | `showImportSheet(context, s, entity: ImportEntity.questions)`. Tooltip (19.0.3.23.0): CSV and harness JSON arrive here as drafts; a native bank export restores straight into the bank |
| `Undo` (rendered only when `s.lastDecision != null`) | 209-211 | `s.undoDecision` |
| `_FilterRow` `All n` + one `Btn` per generator with pending drafts | 342-358 | reads `store.generators`, `store.pendingDrafts(g.id)`; sets local `_gen` |
| `Preview as candidate` | 407-411 | `showQuestionPreview` |
| `Open generator` (only when the generator is known) | 412-419 | `nav.generator(g.id, tab: 'drafts')` |
| `Retry clips` (only when `videoState` is `failed` or `partial`) | 423-432 | `store.retryVideo(draft.id)` → `POST /api/v1/drafts/<id>/retry_video` |
| `Rebuild answer key` (only when `!draft.answerKeyValid`) | 433-440 | `store.rebuildAnswerKey(draft.id)` → `POST /api/v1/drafts/<id>/rebuild_answer_key` |
| `Edit` (`null` when `!isLive`; busy on `draft:<id>`) | 447-455 | `showDraftEditor(context, store, draft)` |
| `Deny` (`Btn.danger`, keyHint D) | 459-463 | `_decide(cur, DraftState.denied)` |
| `Skip` (keyHint J) | 473 | `_move(1)` |
| `Approve into bank` (keyHint A) | 475-481 | `_decide(cur, DraftState.approved)`; disabled unless `canApprove` |
| `_AckBox` (only when blocking warnings exist) | 552-559 | `store.toggleAck(draft.id)` |
| `Approve marking guide` / `Withdraw sign-off` | 795-802 | `store.signRubric(draft.id)` |
| `_ReplaceImageBtn` (one per slot) | 658-734 | `store.applyUploadedImage(draft.id, image: base64, slot:)` |
| `_QueueList` row tap | 942-943 | sets `_idx`, then `_hydrateCurrent` |

`canApprove = blocking.isEmpty || acked` (:397). `store.acknowledged` is a `Set<String>` of draft ids (app_store.dart:1012-1015). The comment at :478-479 states the intent plainly: the button is the courtesy, the store is the guarantee.

**Approve/deny persistence** (`decideDraft`, app_store.dart::decideDraft): edits `drafts` locally, appends to `bank` on approval with `approvedOn: DateTime.now()` and `answerKeyValid: d.hasCompleteKey`, records `lastDecision`, then fires an **unawaited** `_act` calling `approveDraft`/`denyDraft` (`POST /api/v1/drafts/<id>/approve|deny`, api_client.dart:941-953) so the reviewer never waits a round trip per card.

##### 4b. Image handling

`_StimulusBlock` (:569-648) renders in this precedence:

1. `imageState == failed` → bad `Notice` quoting `draft.imageError` (fallback "The image was never created.") plus a primary `_ReplaceImageBtn`.
2. `imageState == rendering` → a static `JobCard('Creating the image', running, meta: '~40s', progress: 55)` - the meta and progress are hardcoded literals (:613-618), not read from any job.
3. both `images` and `videos` empty → `MissingStimulus()`.
4. otherwise → a `Row` of `StimulusPlate` per image (`showRegions` only for `QType.imageLabel`) and `VideoPlate` per video.

The block is only rendered when the draft has images, videos, or a non-null `imageState`/`videoState` (:513-517).

`_ReplaceImageBtn` (:658-734): slots come from `draft.images.map((a) => a.slot.toLowerCase())`, deduplicated and sorted; when that is empty (which is exactly the failed-render case) it falls back to `['a', 'b']` (:676-687). It renders one button per slot - "Replace" for a single slot, "Replace A"/"Replace B" otherwise. `_pick` accepts `.png,.jpg,.jpeg,.webp,.gif`, base64-encodes the bytes, and calls `applyUploadedImage` → `POST /api/v1/drafts/<id>/apply_image` with `{image, slot}` (api_client.dart:725-731). Disabled when `!store.isLive`; busy on `image:<id>`.

Consequence of the fallback: a single-plate question whose render failed shows two buttons, "Replace A" and "Replace B", one of which fills a slot the question type does not use.

##### 4c. Answer key panel (`_AnswerKey`, :737-848)

Two shapes. For a subjective type with no dimensions: the numbered rubric lines (or a note that the grader will author one), the `boxKey` "Expected labels" badges when non-empty, and the rubric sign-off pill plus button. For everything else: one row of option badges per dimension (`✓` prefix and `Tone.accent` on correct ones), plus a bad `Notice` when `keyless` (`any dim lacks a key, or dims is empty`, :808-809).

##### 4d. Problems in this screen

| Item | Where | Problem |
|---|---|---|
| `Waiting for images` KPI | 182-188, 228-233 | Counts drafts whose **blocking** warnings have a title containing `'Image'`. The blocking warning titles produced by `Question.warnings` are `No source reference`, `A distractor reveals the answer`, `No answer key`, `Stimulus failed to render` (models.dart::warnings). None contains "Image", so this KPI is permanently `0`. |
| `Undo` button and the `U` key | 209-211, 155-156 | `undoDecision` (app_store.dart::undoDecision) reverts `drafts` and `bank` in memory and calls **no** API. The approve/deny it reverses already fired `_act`, whose `finally` runs `refresh(background: true)` (app_store.dart::refresh), so the server state is re-fetched and the undo is silently reversed. |
| `Approve marking guide` on a draft | 795-801 | `signRubric` posts to `POST /api/v1/bank/<questionId>/review_rubric` (api_client.dart:861-866) using a **draft** id. The store flips `rubricReviewed` locally on both `drafts` and `bank` first, so the UI shows a sign-off regardless of whether the request succeeds. |
| `Rebuild answer key` | 433-440 | Gated on `!draft.answerKeyValid`. `Question.answerKeyValid` defaults to `true` and, per the field's own documentation, drafts do not carry it (models.dart:506-511, 853). If that comment is accurate the condition is always false and the button is unreachable from the review queue. UNKNOWN: whether `/api/v1/drafts/<id>` actually sends `has_valid_key`. |
| `Import CSV / JSON` destination copy | 204-208 | FIXED: the `into` argument is gone; the sheet takes an `ImportEntity` and says where the file lands - see §5. |
| `Retry clips` | 423-432 | Real (`retryVideo` calls the API, app_store.dart::retryVideo) but note the store re-checks the failure state and toasts instead of calling when it does not hold. |
| Hardcoded rendering progress | 613-618 | `meta: '~40s'`, `progress: 55` are invented constants shown as if they were live job telemetry. |

#### 5. `bank_screen.dart` - Question bank

**Purpose.** The approved, reusable pool; the only source an assessment can draw from (:1-6).

**Layout.** `PageHead` (with an `Import` action) → `KpiStrip` (5) → conditional invalid-key `Notice` → `Panel(flush)` with `Toolbar` (search + type select + count chip) and a `DataGrid`.

| Control | Where | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| `Btn('Import')` | 74-78 | `showImportSheet(context, s, entity: ImportEntity.questions)`. Tooltip (19.0.3.23.0, S11): "CSV and harness JSON arrive as drafts in the review queue; a native bank export restores straight into the live bank." - it used to claim every file arrived as drafts |
| `SearchField` | 133-137 | local; matches `b.name` and `b.prompt` (:52-53) |
| `SelectField<String>` type filter | | `'all'` sentinel plus every `QType.known` entry - the seven real types, never `unsupported` (round 3) |
| `TagChip` | 149 | display |
| Empty-state action | 167-180 | unfiltered: `Go to review queue`. Filtered: `Clear filters` |
| Row `onTap` | 238 | `showQuestionPreview(context, s, b)` - there is no per-row button (:237) |

KPIs: `all.length`; `active` count; `invalid` = `!b.answerKeyValid`; `unreviewed` = subjective && `!rubricReviewed`; `typesInUse` rendered as `"$typesInUse of ${QType.known.length}"` (:110-118), derived rather than hardcoded; both sides count known types only (round 3).

##### Columns and whether a real server field backs each

| Column | Cell content | Backing field | Real server field? |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Question` (flex 3) | `GridLink(b.name)` over one ellipsised line of `b.prompt` | `name`, `prompt` | Yes - `Question.fromJson` reads both |
| `Type` (112) | `StatusBadge(b.type.short)` | `question_type` → `QType` | Yes (enums.dart:398-424) |
| `Generator` (flex 2) | `s.genById(b.genId)?.name ?? b.genId` | `genId` | Yes, but falls back to printing the raw id when the generator is not in the local list |
| `Readiness` (168) | `_Readiness` widget (:258-277) | `answerKeyValid`, `type.isObjective`, `rubricReviewed` | `answerKeyValid ← answerKeyValid \| hasValidKey`, defaulting to **true** (models.dart:853); `rubricReviewed ← rubricReviewed`, defaulting to false |
| `Used in` (70, numeric) | `Mono('${b.usedIn}')` | `usedIn ← usedIn \| used_in`, default 0 (models.dart:859) | UNKNOWN whether `/api/v1/bank` sends it; seed data sets it explicitly (seed_data.dart:411 etc.) |
| `Approved` (150; 132 before 19.0.3.23.0) | `_when(b.approvedOn)` - an IST timestamp - over an `Active`/`Retired` pill | `approvedOn ← DateTime.tryParse(approvedOn\|approved_on)`, `active` | `approvedOn` is **never** set in `seed_data.dart` and is only written locally by `decideDraft` (app_store.dart::decideDraft), so in seed mode this reads `-` for every row. UNKNOWN whether the live bank route sends it. `active` has a real field. |

`_Readiness` precedence (:264-275): invalid key wins (`No correct option`, bad); objective questions always read `Ready`; subjective read `Ready` or `Rubric unreviewed`.

**Problems.**
- The comment at :153-156 says the grid is "Sized for the SEVEN columns this table has" - there are six `Col` entries (:181-196) and six cells per row. The same comment block says the merged pair became "PROVENANCE" (:190) but the column is labelled `Approved`.
- `_when` prints `istTimestamp` since 19.0.3.23.0 ("18 Sep, 10:03 AM IST"); it used to be `d/m/yyyy` with no zero-padding and no zone. The grid `minWidth` went 1040 → 1058 for the wider column.
- **Where an import lands, and what the sheet says** (corrected for 19.0.3.23.0; the old `into` / `payloadFromText` / `_runImport` path described here before is gone). Both entry points call `showImportSheet(context, store, entity: ImportEntity.questions)`; the sheet sends the raw file to the server (`store.importFile`), whose importer (`run_import` in `bank_import_wizard.py`) decides: a native bank export (an object with a truthy `assessments_be_bank` and a `questions` list) is RESTORED straight into the live bank, CSV and harness JSON become drafts in the review queue (S11, row 37). The sub line is `ImportEntity.questions.sub`, which now says exactly that. The primary button is worded as Odoo's dialog words it, from a client copy of the same sniff run once per picked file (`_questionImportLabel`, FU6/FU10): "Restore into the bank" for a native export, "Import as drafts" for harness JSON (first row has `fields`, or `instruction` + `id`) and for anything that is not JSON (read as CSV), plain "Import" for other JSON; a leading byte-order mark does not change the answer (FU11). Test: `import_sheets_enable_their_button_test.dart`.
- There is no per-row edit control. Reaching `showBankEditor` requires opening the preview sheet and pressing "Edit this question", which itself is rendered only when `store.isLive` (assessment_detail_screen.dart:1499-1517).

#### 6. `tags_screen.dart` - Tag vocabulary

**Purpose.** One shared vocabulary grouped by facet prefix. The header comment argues that a near-duplicate tag is a correctness problem, because similarity detection compares tag sets (:1-8).

**Layout.** `PageHead` (one action) → `KpiStrip` (4) → conditional near-duplicate `Notice` → either an empty `Panel` or one `_FacetPanel` per facet, in insertion order (:36-41).

| Control | Where | Store method | Route |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Normalize vocabulary` (busy on `normalizetags`) | 63-70 | `store.normalizeTags` | `POST /api/v1/tags/normalize` with `generator_ids` (api_client.dart:1254-1257); the store scopes it to generators with tags and refuses when that set is empty (app_store.dart:3559-3581) |
| `Merge all` (in the warn `Notice`) | 112-118 | `store.mergeAllTags` | one `POST /api/v1/tags/merge` per canonical target (app_store.dart:3616-3641) |
| Per-row `Merge into <target>` (non-canonical rows only) | 223-230 | `store.mergeTag(tag.name)` - passes the **full** faceted name deliberately (:225-228) | `POST /api/v1/tags/merge` with `{target_id, source_ids}` (api_client.dart:1246-1252) |

`_FacetPanel` columns (:192-197): `Tag` (bare name, prefix stripped by `_shortName`), `Used by` (`tag.uses`), `Status` (`Canonical` pill or `Merge into <short>` warn pill), and an unnamed 132px action column.

**KPIs.** `all.length` with "across N facets"; `canonical` = total minus strays; `strays.length`; and `Most used`, computed by a linear scan over canonical tags only (:45-49), showing the bare name with facet and use count on the sub-line.

**Helpers.** `_headingFor` turns `output-format` into `Output format` (:152-156). `_shortName` strips the `facet:` prefix and takes a nullable name because `Tag.mergeInto` is null for canonical tags (:163-167).

**Notes.**
- The canonical-row action cell is **not a control**: it renders plain text, `used Nx` or `unused` (:218-222). The comment at :211-217 states this is deliberate because the module has no rename route, and that a `Rename` button that only explains itself would read as broken.
- Everything on this screen that concerns duplicates - the `Near-duplicates` KPI, the warn `Notice`, `Merge all`, and every per-row merge button - depends on `Tag.mergeInto`, which `Tag.fromJson` reads from `mergeInto`/`merge_into` (models.dart::mergeInto). That key is set only in `seed_data.dart:1538-1544` and one test. UNKNOWN: whether `/api/v1/tags` sends `merge_into`. If it does not, every tag is canonical against a live server and this entire feature is inert.
- `mergeTag`/`mergeAllTags` bail with "Cannot merge - the tag has no server id" when `Tag.id` is empty, which is the case in seed mode (models.dart::id).
- `normalizeTags` and both merge paths short-circuit with an info toast when `!isLive`; the buttons themselves stay enabled, so in seed mode they are pressable and do nothing but toast.

#### 7. `scoring_screen.dart` - Scoring

**Purpose.** A live view of the subjective grading pipeline. The header comment states the screen exists because `/api/v1/scoring` was never called, and that it exists specifically to make one silent failure visible: an assessment with auto-grading off never queues submits, so the pipeline sits at zero with no error recorded anywhere (:1-14).

**What it reads.** Only `store.scoring`, a raw `Map<String, dynamic>` set by `loadScoring` from `/api/v1/scoring` (app_store.dart:2992-3006, api_client.dart:616-619). `loadScoring` returns immediately when `!_live` (app_store.dart::loadScoring), so `scoring` is empty in seed mode. Two typed accessors:

- `_lane(key)` (:47-51) reads `scoring['lanes'][key]` as an int, 0 when absent.
- `_int(key)` (:53-56) reads a top-level int.

Derived values (:68-79): `pending`, `scoring`, `scored`, `partial`, `failed`, `errored` from lanes; `queued` from the top level; `waiting = pending + scoring + partial + failed`; `starved = waiting > 0 && queued == 0`. Stuck rows are parsed from `scoring['errored']` as a list of `Attempt.fromJson` (:81-85).

**Meaning of the two terms the prompt asks about.**

| Term | Where it comes from | What it means on this screen |
|---|---|---|
| `queued` | top-level `queued` from `/api/v1/scoring`, KPI sub-line "picked up by the cron" (:151) | How many attempts have been handed to the module's cron. `queueScoring`'s own doc says the LLM call happens in the cron, not on the request (api_client.dart:836-841). |
| `pending` | the `pending` lane, `Field.readonly` help "Waiting for the grader to reach them." (:166-167) | One of the six lanes an attempt can sit in; it is also a component of the `Waiting` KPI. |

`Waiting` (the KPI, :145-150) is not the same as `pending` (the lane, :166): the KPI sums four lanes.

**Layout and controls.**

| Element | Where | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| `Btn('Refresh')` (busy on `scoring`) | 93-97 | `s.loadScoring()`; `null` when `!s.isLive` |
| `Btn.primary('Queue everything waiting')` (busy on `scoring:queue`) | 98-104 | `s.queueScoringFor()` → `POST /api/v1/scoring/queue` with `{assessment_id?, evaluator_ids: []}` (api_client.dart:842-849); enabled only when `s.isLive && waiting > 0` |
| Seed-mode `Notice` | 112-117 | shown when `scoring.isEmpty && !isLive` |
| `InlineBusy` | 118-119 | shown when `isBusy('scoring') && scoring.isEmpty` |
| Starvation `Notice` | 121-132 | shown when `starved` |
| Terminal-error `Notice` | 133-142 | shown when `errored > 0` |
| `KpiStrip` | 144-160 | Waiting, Queued, In flight (`scoring` lane), Graded (`scored`), Terminal errors |
| `Panel('Lanes')` | 162-179 | six `Field.readonly` rows: Pending, Scoring, Partial, Scored, Failed, Terminal error, each with help text |
| `Panel('Stuck attempts')` → `Re-run all errored` | 181-194 | `s.requeueErrored(attemptIds: stuck.map((a) => a.id))` → `POST /api/v1/scoring/requeue_errored` with `evaluator_ids` (api_client.dart:855-858); rendered only when `stuck` is non-empty |
| Stuck `DataGrid` | 199-218 | columns `Candidate` (`s.personById(a.employeeId)?.name ?? a.employeeId`), `Assessment` (`a.assessmentName`), `State` (a constant `Terminal error` badge); row `onTap` → `nav.attempt(a.id)` |

**Problems.**
- `waiting` includes the `scoring` lane (:75), which is also surfaced separately as the `In flight` KPI (:152). An attempt actively being graded is counted as "not yet graded".
- Because of that, `starved` (:79) can fire while the grader is actually working: if every waiting attempt is in flight and `queued` has drained to 0, the screen shows "Answers are waiting and nothing is queued to grade them." UNKNOWN: whether the server's `queued` counter includes in-flight rows, which would prevent it.
- `Refresh` is disabled when `!isLive` with no on-screen reason; the seed `Notice` explains only the empty body, not the disabled button.
- The stuck grid renders `assessmentName`, which `Attempt.fromJson` reads as `name` first and `assessmentName` second (models.dart::assessmentName). UNKNOWN: whether the `errored` rows in the scoring payload carry either key; if not, the Assessment column is blank.
- The `State` column is a constant badge (:213) and carries no information beyond the panel title.

#### 8. `lib/assessment/widgets/question_editor.dart` - the shared editor

Two entry points over one widget (:41-64):

| Function | Sheet title / sub | `isDraft` | Callers |
|---|---|---|---|
| `showDraftEditor` | "Edit draft" / "Fix it here rather than denying and regenerating." | true | review_queue_screen.dart:453; assessment_detail_screen.dart:1512 |
| `showBankEditor` | "Edit question" / "Changes apply to everyone who has already sat it." | false | assessment_detail_screen.dart:1514 |

**Two record shapes, one form** (:9-14). A draft stores options as a flat `List<String>` plus the correct option **text** (`options_json`/`correct_answer_json`); a bank question stores real dimension and option records with ids. `initState` (:66-90) loads either shape into `_EditOption` rows; the bank branch reads only `q.dims.first`, keeping `_dimensionId` and `_dimensionName`.

**Every editable field**

| Field | Where | Sent on the draft path | Sent on the bank path |
|---|---|---|---|
| Title (`_name`) | 250-257 | `name` → `POST /api/v1/drafts/<id>/update` (api_client.dart:643-661) | `name` → `POST /api/v1/bank/<id>/update` (api_client.dart:670-689) |
| Question (`_prompt`, 2-6 lines) | 259-268 | `question_prompt` | `prompt` |
| Difficulty (3 `Btn`s with `pressed`) | 272-288 | `difficulty` (`Difficulty.wire`: easy/medium/hard) | `difficulty` |
| `In circulation` / `Retired` `SwitchRow` (bank only, :291) | 291-303 | not sent | `active` |
| Options list (objective types only) | 306-363 | `options` (list of trimmed strings) + `correct_answer` (a single String for mcq, a `List<String>` for msq/imageAb) | `dimensions`: one row `{id?, name, options: [{id?, name, is_correct}]}` |
| Per-option `Correct` `SwitchRow` | 332-340 | via `correct_answer` | via `is_correct` |
| Per-option text `TextField` | 342-349 | via `options` | via `name` |
| Per-option `IconBtn(close)` | 350-359 | removes the row locally | removes the row, which the server treats as a delete |
| `Add option` | 317-323 | appends an empty `_EditOption` | same |
| `Cancel` / `Save` | 369-380 | `Save` disabled while `_problem != null`; busy on `draft:<id>` / `bank:<id>` (:232-234) | same |

`_objective` is `mcq || msq || imageAb` (:99-102) - broader than `QType.isObjective`, which is mcq/msq only (enums.dart::isObjective). `_single` is `mcq` alone (:104). The bank sheet also renders a permanent warn `Notice` about re-deciding existing marks (:240-248).

**Client-side validation (`_problem`, :143-157).** Applies only when `_objective`; returns null for every other type, so Save is always enabled for subjective questions.

| Rule | Message |
|---|---|
| fewer than 2 non-empty options | "A question needs at least two options." |
| zero options marked correct | "Nothing is marked correct, so nobody could ever score on it." |
| `_single` and more than one correct | "A single-answer question can only have one correct option." |

`_toggle` (:159-171) enforces radio behaviour for `_single` by clearing every other row before setting the new one. The comment at :142 states the server enforces the same rules as a guarantee.

**Not validated client-side:** empty title, empty prompt (both are sent as `''`, which the `?`-omission in `_call` does **not** strip since `''` is non-null), duplicate option texts, options that are whitespace-only after other rows have been trimmed away, and anything at all for subjective/media types.

**Fields the editor does not touch** even though the store and API accept them: `description`, `timeMinutes`, `officialReasoning` (both paths), and `rubricReviewed` (bank path) - see `saveDraft` (app_store.dart::saveDraft) and `saveBankQuestion` (app_store.dart::saveBankQuestion). It also cannot edit the rubric text, tags, label boxes, or media.

**Serious defect.** For a bank question the editor reads only `q.dims.first` (:123) and sends a `dimensions` list containing exactly one row (:205-222). The API documents that list as the whole intended key: "a row with an `id` updates, one without creates, and anything omitted is removed" (api_client.dart:664-668). Saving a multi-dimension bank question through this editor therefore deletes every dimension after the first, along with its options. Nothing in the UI shows the second dimension or warns that it will be dropped.

Secondary: `_dimensionName` falls back to the literal `'Answer'` (:90, 125) when the loaded question has no dimension, so a save on an unhydrated objective bank row could rename the axis. In practice `showQuestionPreview` hydrates first (assessment_detail_screen.dart::showQuestionPreview), so this is reachable only if the editor is opened from an unhydrated path.

## 3.7 Screens: operations and member

All seven files were read in full. Two headline corrections to the brief, stated up front because everything below depends on them:

1. **`budget_screen.dart` contains no LLM/Vertex configuration, no service-account key upload, and no "Vertex unconfigured" state.** It is a read-only spend-reporting screen. There is no file picker, no credential field, and no upload call anywhere in its 911 lines. A repo-wide grep for `vertex`, `service.account`, `credential`, `gcp`, `project_id`, `FilePicker`, `pickFiles` over `lib/**.dart` returns only incidental mentions: an error string in `lib/assessment/state/seed_data.dart:1147`, prose comments at `lib/assessment/state/app_store.dart:2197` and `:2250`, a tooltip at `lib/assessment/screens/admin/scoring_screen.dart:169`, and a comment at `lib/assessment/data/api_client.dart:853`. **UNKNOWN: where (if anywhere) a Vertex service-account key is uploaded** - it is not in this Flutter front end. Model names are displayed on `settings_screen.dart`, read back from the server; they are not editable from any screen in this repo. *(scoring_screen.dart: removed since 19.0.3.12.0)*
2. **`my_results_screen.dart` was a 4-line re-export and is deleted (round 3, A-105); the class it re-exported, `MyResultsScreen`, is still not routed anywhere.** Details below.

#### budget_screen

**What it actually exposes.** No LLM or Vertex *settings* at all. It exposes spend measurements only:

| Block | Contents | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `_TodayPanel` (`:830-911`) | Notice when capped or uncapped; KPIs "Spent today", "Remaining today", "Per-candidate cap" | `store.budgetToday` (`/api/v1/budget` -> `budget['today']`, `state/app_store.dart::budgetToday`) and `store.budget['per_evaluator_cap_usd']` |
| KPI strip 1, `minWidth: 240` (`:162-197`) | Total cost, Requests, Total tokens, Avg per request, Images, Video seconds | Total cost and Requests from `store.budgetLifetime` ("estimated, all time" / "model calls, all time"), Avg per request = lifetime cost / lifetime calls (19.0.3.23.0, Q18/F2-01: the cards used to sum only the newest 1,000 held rows - $63.28 shown against $285.67 real). The rest summed from `store.ledger`. When the held rows are a sample (lifetime calls exceed them, or the server sends no lifetime) each summed card's sub-line reads "last N calls" instead of its unit, and a server without `lifetime` falls back to the sums with that note |
| KPI strip 2 (`:198-211`) | Tokens in, Tokens out, Thinking tokens, Authoring share % | summed from `store.ledger`, with the same "last N calls" sub-line when sampled |
| Cost by operation (`:221-232`) | Horizontal bars, all operations, no cap on row count | `costByOp`, keyed on `LedgerOp.label` |
| Tokens by operation (`:233-242`) | Stacked in/out/thinking bars, top 6 by total | `tokensByOp` |
| Tokens by model (`:246-257`) | Horizontal bars, top 6 | `tokByModel` |
| Requests by operation (`:258-267`) | Column chart, top 6 | `reqByOp` |
| Cost by project (`:270-302`) | One card per generator, authoring vs evaluation split, plus an `Unattributed` card | `byProject`, attribution loop `:89-112` |

**Attribution logic** (`:89-112`): a row with `genId` bills that generator; otherwise `evId` -> `attemptById` -> `asmById(...).generatorId`; anything resolving to neither is accumulated into `unattributed`/`unattributedReq` and drawn as its own recessed card (`:767-803`). Authoring vs evaluation is decided by `LedgerOp.isAuthoring` (`domain/enums.dart::isAuthoring`), which counts `extract_tags`, `generate_questions`, `render_image`, `render_video`, `detect_regions`, `similarity`, `generate_image`, `submit_video_op`, `verify_planted_flaws` and, since 19.0.3.23.0, `extract_skills`, `detect_image_elements`, `locate_defect`, `generate_video`, `fetch_video_op`, `assign_question_skills`, `draft_task_template`, `consolidate_vocab`, `map_similarity` as authoring; everything else - the scoring ops and `scoring_cache_create` / `scoring_cache_refresh` included - is evaluation. Every `llm_usage.operation` value now has its own label; before, eleven of them fell through to "Other". The panels below the cards still sum only the held rows, with no "last N calls" note (known leftover, `ETP_PLANS_AND_STRATEGY.md` Part 0 §0.2 E).

**Budget caps.** The screen reads three cap-related values, and writes none of them:
- `today.cap_usd` - the daily cap, from `/api/v1/budget`. `cap <= 0` is treated as "no cap set" (`:842`).
- `today.remaining_usd` - explicitly nullable; null renders as `-`, not `$0.00` (`:886-889`, and `state/app_store.dart:604-608`).
- `budget['per_evaluator_cap_usd']` - top-level on the budget payload, *not* under `today`. The code comment at `:905-907` records that the settings-side key is `per_evaluator_llm_cap_usd` and that reading the settings name here reported "none" over a real cap.

Tone escalation: `Tone.bad` when `capped`, `Tone.warn` at `frac >= 0.8`, else `Tone.ok` (`:5001-5003`). Both notices point the operator at Settings to change the cap (`:864-874`) - the cap is not editable here.

**What the screen shows when the budget aggregate is missing** (the nearest real analogue to the brief's "Vertex unconfigured"): `_TodayPanel` returns `SizedBox.shrink()` when `store.budgetToday` is null (`:837-840`), i.e. the whole Today block silently disappears. That happens in seed mode, because `AppStore._load()` populates `ledger` from fixtures but never sets `budget` or `settings` (`state/app_store.dart:652-663`), and after `_clear()` which resets `budget = {}` (`state/app_store.dart:511`). Every chart has its own `emptyMessage` for the zero-rows case (`:228-230`, `:238-240`, `:253-255`, `:263-265`, `:279-282`).

**Problems found:**
- The `Notice` at `:212-218` says "Every card above opens the underlying ledger". Only 3 of the 10 KPI cards carry an `onTap`, and the code's own comment two screens up says so plainly ("Three of these six navigate", `:152-153`). The copy contradicts the behaviour.
- `authoringShare` (`:117-123`) divides authoring spend (attributed rows only) by `totalCost` (all rows including unattributed). With any unattributed spend the percentage understates authoring share, and the two figures come from different denominators.
- `usd()` and `nf()` are public top-level functions in this screen file (`:809`, `:813`) and are imported by `ledger_screen.dart` via `import 'budget_screen.dart'` (`ledger_screen.dart:15`). A number-formatting helper living in a screen file is a layering oddity, not a bug.

`videoSeconds`, `note`, `at` and `id` are carried on `LedgerRow` (`domain/models.dart::LedgerRow`) but are not columns; they appear only in the detail sheet.

**"Expandability" - there is none in the inline sense.** The row does not expand; `GridRow(onTap: ...)` opens a modal dialog through `showSheet` (`:123`, `:165-233`; `widgets/controls.dart:353-361`, which is a `showDialog` with a scrim, max width 640). The sheet contains: a header field grid (Operation, Model, Attributed to with a help line naming `Generator <id>` / `Attempt <id>` / "No record claimed this call", When via `istTimestamp` - the local `_stamp` helper was removed in 19.0.3.23.0); a **Tokens** panel with input/output/thinking, where zero thinking renders as the words `none returned` rather than `0` (`:199-203`); a **Media** panel rendered only when `images > 0 || videoSeconds > 0` (`:206-217`); and a **Cost** panel with the call cost and the ledger id, help text "The same row Odoo shows under LLM Usage" (`:219-229`).

**Cross-links, both directions:**
- Budget -> Ledger: header `Btn('Ledger')` (`budget_screen.dart:137-139`) and three KPI `onTap`s (`:168`, `:174`, `:180`), all `context.nav.go(const LedgerAdmin())`.
- Ledger -> Budget: header `Btn('LLM budget')` -> `context.nav.go(const BudgetAdmin())` (`ledger_screen.dart:85-88`).
- Breadcrumb `Admin > LLM budget > Ledger` (`:70-74`) is **not clickable**: `Crumb` takes an optional `onTap` and all three are constructed without one, so `Crumbs` renders them as plain `Text` (`widgets/panel.dart:43-54`, `:66-72`). The middle crumb looks like a link to Budget but is not one.
- Ledger is deliberately absent from the sidebar (`domain/nav_entries.dart:91-94`), reachable only from Budget - though `_openTab`/`_activeTabKey` still handle the `'ledger'` key (`assessment_section.dart:355`, `:394`), so a deep link by key would work.

Pagination is client-side over the whole in-memory list (`:59-66`); the store fetches all pages via `_allPages(... _api.ledger ...)` (`state/app_store.dart:297`), and `api_client.dart:1279-1283` documents that this route takes `limit`/`offset` and silently caps at 40 if the wrong names are sent.

#### settings_screen

Every value on this screen comes from the server. **There are no local preferences on this screen** - no `SharedPreferences`, no prefs import, no persisted client state. The only client-local state is the `_dirty` flag and the four `TextEditingController`s (`:246-256`).

| Panel | Field (label) | Payload path in `store.settings` | Read/write |
|---|---|---|---|
| Models | Generation model | `models.generation` | read-only (`:59`, `_model` `:207-212`) |
| Models | Scoring model | `models.scoring` | read-only (`:60`) |
| Models | Detection model | `models.detection` | read-only (`:61`) |
| Models | Image model | `models.image` | read-only (`:62`) |
| Models | Video model | `models.video` | read-only (`:63`) |
| Models | Fallback model | `models.fallback` | read-only, carries a `StatusBadge('Used when the primary refuses', Tone.warn)` (`:64-84`) |
| Scoring | Retry attempts | `scoring.llm_max_attempts` | read-only (`:94-100`) |
| Scoring | Batch size | `scoring.batch_size` | read-only (`:101-105`) |
| Scoring | Tick limit | `scoring.tick_limit` | read-only (`:106-110`) |
| Scoring | Shards | `scoring.shards` | read-only (`:111-115`) |
| Storage | Image storage bucket | `storage.s3_bucket` | read-only (`:152-155`) |
| Storage | Region | `storage.s3_region` | read-only (`:156`) |
| Storage | CDN base URL | `storage.s3_cdn_url` | read-only (`:157-160`) |
| Storage | (gate, not a field) | `storage.configured == true` | drives the "No object storage is configured" warning (`:140-150`, `_storageConfigured` `:199-200`) |
| Retention and spend | Daily LLM cap (USD) | `governance.daily_llm_cap_usd` | **editable** |
| Retention and spend | Per-candidate LLM cap (USD) | `governance.per_evaluator_llm_cap_usd` | **editable** |
| Retention and spend | PII retention (days) | `governance.pii_retention_days` | **editable** |
| Retention and spend | Score outlier threshold (sigma) | `governance.score_outlier_sigma` | **editable** |

**This table predates the settings-parity wave** (plan Part 4 §4.8): Models, Vertex, Scoring and Storage are now `_EditPanel`s and the spend numbers a `_GovernancePanel`, each with its own Save through `store.saveSettings` -> `POST /api/v1/settings/update`; the "read-only" cells above describe the older screen. What 19.0.3.23.0 adds to it:
- **Scoring model in use** (row 18). The Scoring panel's header shows `settings.scoring.resolved_model.model` - the model scoring really runs on after every fallback, resolved by the server the way the grader resolves it, since the Scoring model box is an override that is often blank. A warn `Notice` follows when the module's catalog has no price (`price_known == false`: spend is estimated at the catalog default rate, so the ledger and the caps are approximate) or no capability data (`capabilities_known == false`: reply budgets go out uncapped). A key the server does not send is not a warning, and a server a deploy behind (no `resolved_model`) shows nothing.
- **Parallel calls** (`scoring_parallel_calls`, read `scoring.parallel_calls`; rows 5, N1). An integer: judge calls each shard keeps in flight, 1-8. The box always shows the STORED value (it is posted back on Save); when the module lowers it at runtime to fit the database connection pool (`scoring.parallel_calls_effective` differs), a warn line under the box reads "In use per lane: N - lowered to fit the database connection pool."
- **Default pass threshold (%)** (`default_pass_threshold`, read `scoring.default_pass_threshold`; Q20). An integer, 1-100, first in the Scoring panel: the pass threshold a NEW assessment starts with; the New Assessment form pre-fills from it. Changing it never touches existing assessments. 0 or 101 comes back as a 422 toast "default_pass_threshold must be between 1 and 100." (the key, not the label). Test: `the_pass_threshold_is_editable_test.dart`.
- **No hints** on Scoring model, Fallback model or Thinking level any more (S10/F2-02): prod stores blank there, and a model name printed as the hint read as the stored value.
Test: `settings_show_what_is_really_in_use_test.dart`.

Placeholders are deliberate and distinct: missing strings render `not configured` (`_text` `:183-186`), missing ints render `not set` (`_int` `:189-193`), missing model names render `not set (module default)` (`:211`).

Validation on save (`:261-278`): each non-empty field is `num.tryParse`d; a non-number or a negative aborts the whole save with `toaster.bad('<key> must be a number, 0 or more')`; empty fields are skipped entirely; if nothing parsed, `_save` returns without a call. Keys go on the wire **unqualified** - the comment at `:232-238` records that sending `assessments_be_v2.`-prefixed names matched nothing server-side and the route still answered `ok` with `updated: {}`.

**Problems found:**
- **Off-by-one in the documentation, three places.** The class doc says "The five numbers `/api/v1/settings/update` allows" (`:214`), the prose repeats "These five are different" (`:219`), and `AppStore.saveGovernance` says "Write the five governance numbers the server allows" (`state/app_store.dart:3526`). `_keys` lists **four** (`:239-244`) and the panel renders four. Either a fifth key was dropped or the comment was always wrong. **UNKNOWN: whether the server allow-list has a fifth key this screen no longer surfaces.**
- **Controllers seed once and never re-seed.** `_c` uses `putIfAbsent` against `_section(store, 'governance')` (`:253-256`). The comment explains this protects in-progress typing from background refreshes. It also means that if the panel first builds before `/api/v1/settings` has landed - which is the normal case on a cold open, since `settings` is populated only inside `_loadAdmin` (`state/app_store.dart::_loadAdmin`) - all four fields seed to `''` and stay empty for the life of the widget, even after the payload arrives. In seed mode they are permanently empty because `settings` is never populated at all.
- Because empty fields are skipped (`:265`), there is no way to clear a cap from this screen; `0` must be typed explicitly, and the help text at `:299-300` says `0` means no cap, "which is not the same as unset".
- `saveGovernance` refuses in seed mode with `toaster.info('Saving settings needs a live backend')` (`state/app_store.dart::saveGovernance`), but `_dirty` is still cleared by `_save` afterwards (`:277`), so the Save button greys out as if the write succeeded.
- Dead whitespace at `:194-197` (three blank lines where a helper appears to have been removed).

#### start_here_screen (rail label "Docs")

The sidebar calls it "Docs" (`domain/nav_entries.dart:95-101`), and the rail comment explains the rename and the move to the bottom of the PLATFORM group. The screen's own `PageHead` still reads **"Start here"** with sub "How this module fits together, and where work is waiting" (`:178-181`) - rail label and page title disagree.

The actual documentation content is three things and nothing else:

1. **One pipeline sentence** (`_Flow`, `:270-299`), rendered as a `Text.rich` with the nouns bolded: a *document* becomes *draft questions*; a human *approves* them into a *bank*; an *assessment* serves them to people; you *release* the results. Followed by a paragraph saying the rail's order is not the work's order and that nothing reaches a candidate without step 2 (`:190-196`).
2. **Five stage cards** (`_stages`, `:50-163`), each with a number, a name, a one-or-two sentence description of what the stage is, a live count, and at most one live alert:

| # | Name | Unit counted | Count expression | Alert condition | Tone | Opens |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Generators | generators | `store.generators.length` | `g.possibleDuplicate` count > 0 -> "N look like duplicates of each other" | warn | `GeneratorList` |
| 2 | Review queue | awaiting review | `store.pendingDrafts().length` | drafts with non-empty `blockingWarnings` -> "N carry a warning you must acknowledge" | warn | `ReviewQueue` |
| 3 | Question bank | active questions | active questions in `store.bank` | objective questions without `hasCompleteKey` -> "N with no correct answer marked" | **bad** | `QuestionBank` |
| 4 | Assessments | live now | assessments in `AsmState.inProgress` | sum of `releasableCount` > 0 -> "N results are waiting to be released" | warn | `nav.assessments` |
| 5 | Results | submitted attempts | attempts in `AttemptState.submitted` | submitted attempts with `subjectiveState == LlmState.error` -> "N blocked by a scoring error" | **bad** | `ResponsesList` |

   Above the cards, a "Needs attention" strip appears only when at least one stage is flagged, with a pill reading "N of 5 stages" tinted bad if any bad alert exists (`:202-221`).

   Note `releasableCount.clamp(0, 1 << 30)` at `:78-81`: `Assessment.releasableCount` defaults to `-1` for "not sent by this endpoint" (`domain/models.dart:1391-1399`), and the clamp is what stops those sentinels producing a negative total.

3. **A "Who sees what" panel** (`:235-262`) documenting exactly three roles: **Manager** (full console; the only role that can release a result or erase a candidate), **Evaluator** (same console, read-only: no launching, releasing or configuration), **Candidate** (own sittings only, score only after release, never a percentage, never another candidate's data, never the answer key). The comment at `:227-234` records that a fourth "Program Manager" role was described here previously and removed because `security/etp_assessment_security.xml` declares only two groups.

There is no API reference, no glossary, no changelog, no field-level documentation, and no external links on this page. It is an orientation dashboard, not a docs site.

#### my_results_screen.dart - deleted

The file was a 4-line re-export shim (`export 'my_assessments_screen.dart' show MyResultsScreen;`) that nothing imported; round 3 deleted it (A-105). `MyResultsScreen` itself is still defined at `member/my_assessments_screen.dart::MyResultsScreen`, and only a test mounts it (`a_date_alone_is_the_india_date_test.dart`). It is dead:
- **There is no `MyResults` route.** `nav.dart` declares `MyAssessments` (`:121`) and `MyPerformance` (`:127`) and no results route; `_page()` has no `MyResults()` arm (`assessment_section.dart::_page`); `memberNav()` lists only two entries (`domain/nav_entries.dart::memberNav`). `MyResultsScreen` is unreachable in the running app.
- Separately, the class itself would be empty against a live candidate session even if routed: it skips any attempt whose assessment is not loaded (`my_assessments_screen.dart:378-379`, `if (asm != null && ev.isDone)`), and the neighbouring screens both document that a candidate's endpoint sends no assessment records (`:47-49`, `:71-74`; `_loadCandidate` at `state/app_store.dart::_loadCandidate` fetches only `/api/v1/me/assessments`). `MyPerformanceScreen` was explicitly fixed for this (`my_performance_screen.dart:113-116`); `MyResultsScreen` was not. It also calls `earnedMarks(asm)`/`result(asm)`/`internalPercent(asm)` throughout, none of which have the server-value fallbacks (`serverEarned`/`serverTotal`/`serverPassed`) the other two screens use.

Read together: `MyResultsScreen` is a superseded screen whose live replacement is `MyPerformanceScreen`, left in the tree.
